title: Werkstudent*in Embedded Software
description:

Wenn du Lust hast, Software zu schreiben, die in echten Maschinen zuverlässig arbeitet, dann lass uns sprechen. Schick uns deine Unterlagen und ein paar Sätze dazu, was dich an Embedded Software reizt.

title: Team Lead SEA / Google Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Für unseren Kunden munique suchen wir die Person, die den umsatzstärksten E-Commerce-Kunden der Agentur übernimmt, das SEA-Team führt und mit den Gründern das Produkt rund um Automatisierung und KI baut.

Google Ads verändert sich gerade schneller als in den zehn Jahren davor. Performance Max, Demand Gen und KI-Bidding nehmen Handgriffe ab, die früher den Job ausgemacht haben — und belohnen die, die Systeme bauen statt Kampagnen zu verwalten. Genau da will unser Kunde munique vorne sein.

Für munique, eine Performance-Boutique aus München, suchen wir deshalb die Person, die das SEA fachlich anführt: Du übernimmst den umsatzstärksten Kunden der Agentur mit Konten von 30–50+ Kampagnen und Jahresbudgets ab 1 Mio. €, führst ein Team von drei SEA-Leuten und treibst als Product Owner fünf bis sechs Automatisierungs- und KI-Projekte voran, die sofort bereitliegen.

Und das nicht aus einer Konzernstruktur heraus: munique hat rund 30 Mitarbeitende, du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern, bist Teil des Leadership-Kreises — und bestimmst selbst, wann und wo du arbeitest.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

Das SEA-Team von munique arbeitet für Marken wie arena, Hessnatur, KIA und Luis Trenker. Für den wichtigsten Kunden und die Weiterentwicklung des ganzen Bereichs wird jetzt die fachliche Spitze neu besetzt.

Gleichzeitig will munique, dass Automatisierung und KI nicht Präsentationsfolie bleiben, sondern die Kundenarbeit messbar besser machen. Dafür braucht es jemanden, der beides kann: tief im Account und mit Lust, das System dahinter zu bauen.

Was du bewegen wirst

Nicht als Aufgabenliste, sondern als das, was in zwölf Monaten anders sein soll:

  • Der Top-Kunde wächst mit dir. Du hast den Account in einer geordneten Übergabe übernommen, führst Performance-Meetings, Jahres-Kick-off und Quarterly — und kannst an Kennzahlen zeigen, was sich verbessert hat.

  • Du bist selbst im Account. Shopping, Performance Max, Search, Demand Gen und YouTube laufen mit sauberem Tracking, Bidding und Feed — und du weißt, warum.

  • Dein Team ist stärker als vorher. Du hast Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche geführt, Auslastung geplant und Personalbedarf in die Leadership-Planung eingebracht.

  • Die ersten KI-Projekte sind live. Neue Google- und Meta-Features sind getestet und in die Kundenarbeit überführt, das eigene Reporting von munique auf ETL-Basis ist weiterentwickelt.

  • Die Kunden wachsen weiter. Du erkennst Potenziale bei Bestandskund:innen und bringst dich bei Pitches und Upselling ein.

Wie bei munique gearbeitet wird

munique ist bewusst eine Boutique: wenige, ausgewählte Kunden, individuelle Strategien statt Standardlösungen. Das Arbeitsmodell fühlt sich an wie Freelancing — mit der Sicherheit einer Festanstellung. Eine Kollegin, die aus der Selbstständigkeit kam, sagt: Beim Wechsel hat sich für sie fast nichts verändert.

  • Zeit und Ort entscheidest du. Jede Woche, jeden Tag individuell — erwartet wird Erreichbarkeit an fünf Tagen, nicht Anwesenheit.

  • Freie Tage legst du selbst fest. Urlaub ohne feste Obergrenze.

  • Jede Stunde zählt. Bedingungsloses Grundgehalt plus Stundenlohn — Mehrstunden werden voll vergütet, dazu ein Bonus an Zielen und Unternehmensergebnis.

  • Mut ist einer der vier Werte von munique. Neue Plattformfunktionen werden früh getestet, daraus wird gelernt — und was wirkt, kommt in die Praxis.

Wen wir suchen

Jemanden, der SEA seit Jahren selbst macht, schon geführt hat — und beides weiter tun will.

Das brauchst du auf jeden Fall

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Google Ads / SEA als Kernaufgabe Du hast ein Team disziplinarisch geführt (mindestens zwei bis drei Personen) und Entwicklungsgespräche selbst verantwortet.

  • Du hast große Konten gesteuert — 30–50+ Kampagnen, siebenstellige Jahresbudgets — und kannst an einem Beispiel erklären, was du verändert hast und was es gebracht hat.

  • Du kannst einen anspruchsvollen Kunden eigenständig führen, strategisch wie im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Du willst weiterhin selbst operativ arbeiten — Führung ist für dich ein Zusatz, kein Ausstieg aus dem Account.

Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Du kennst die Entwicklung der letzten zehn Jahre im SEA-Bereich

  • E-Commerce-Schwerpunkt mit Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen und YouTube

  • Tiefe in Tracking, Conversions, Bidding und Produktfeed

  • Du hast schon eine Automatisierung, ein Script oder ein neues Feature erfolgreich eingeführt

  • Erfahrung aus einer Agentur oder als Freelancer:in

Die Vorteile für dich

  • Abwechslung statt Brandseite — mehrere Marken und Accounts statt jahrelang immer derselbe, inklusive des umsatzstärksten Kunden der Agentur

  • Sparring mit dem Gründer, der SEA selbst kann — als Teamlead wirst du gecoacht und weiterentwickelt, statt allein an der Spitze zu stehen

  • Freelance-Freiheit mit Festanstellung — Arbeitszeit, Ort und freie Tage bestimmst du selbst, Büro in München, remote möglich

  • Grundgehalt plus Stundenlohn — jede Mehrstunde wird bezahlt, dazu ein Bonus an Zielen und Unternehmensergebnis

  • Gestaltung statt Verwaltung — Product Owner für 5–6 Automatisierungs- und KI-Projekte, direkt mit den Gründern

  • Monatliches Extra nach der Probezeit: Wellpass oder Spendit, dazu ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung und zwei bezahlte Tage fürs Ehrenamt

  • Lernen im Team mit Drive — Kolleg:innen, die sich ständig weiterbilden, munique Academy, Peer-Sparring und die Community munique minds

So läuft der Prozess

Der Prozess ist schlank — kein Case, in der Regel rund vier Wochen bis zum Vertragsentwurf.

  1. Kurzes Telefonat mit uns (15 Minuten): passt die Rolle zu dem, was du suchst?

  2. Ausführliches Kennenlernen mit uns (45–60 Minuten) — deine Erfahrung, deine Motivation, deine Fragen.

  3. Online-Interview bei munique, danach persönliche Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführern, HR und jemandem aus dem Team.

  4. Abschlussgespräch zu Vertrag und Konditionen.

Warum du dich jetzt melden solltest

Top-Kunde, eigenes Team und ein KI-Produkt, das du mitbaust — diese Kombination gibt es in großen Agenturen selten, und mit dieser Freiheit fast nie. Wenn du SEA seit Jahren selbst machst und schon geführt hast, ist das die Rolle, in der beides zählt. Ein Gespräch von 15 Minuten reicht, um herauszufinden, ob es passt.

title: Senior FP&A Manager (f/m/d)
description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

 
 

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

How fast can we grow, where should we invest, and what needs to change when performance moves off plan? As Senior FP&A Manager, you will help plancraft answer these questions as we scale across Europe.

You will build the financial view that connects our growth ambitions to what is happening in the business. Working directly with leadership, country teams, and budget owners, you will challenge assumptions, uncover what drives performance, and turn your analysis into recommendations that shape where we put our resources.

There is plenty to build along the way. You will co-own planning, forecasting, and management reporting, make Abacum a live working tool for the business, and use AI and automation to get from data to useful insights faster. Working closely with our Director of Finance and another FP&A Manager, you will have the scope to shape how FP&A operates and make it a function people turn to when they need to make a decision.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own planning and forecasting: Lead annual financial planning, budgeting, monthly forecasting, and quarterly reviews. Connect leadership’s ambitions with realistic assumptions and inputs from across the business.

  • Explain performance and recommend action: Analyse actuals against budget and forecast, investigate variances at account and cost centre level, and translate your findings into clear recommendations.

  • Build visibility across markets: Own country P&Ls and the planning and reporting structures behind them, helping stakeholders understand performance as we expand.

  • Make Abacum the place where planning happens: Own and develop our live planning model, keep it connected to reliable actuals, and make it useful for leadership and budget owners in their daily work.

  • Deliver reporting people can act on: Prepare the monthly management pack and board and investor reporting. Bring together financial performance, business drivers, and SaaS metrics such as CAC, payback, and LTV into a clear story.

  • Partner with the business: Work with budget owners on planning inputs, spending, and performance. Challenge assumptions constructively and raise risks and opportunities early.

  • Automate recurring work: Use AI and automation to improve data preparation, reporting, and planning workflows, with clear checks that keep outputs accurate and explainable.

  • Support the wider Finance agenda: Work with the Director of Finance on projects, implementations, and the financial analysis behind funding rounds. Partner with Accounting and Finance Operations on reconciliations, data quality, and audit readiness.

Your Profile

  • Exceptional communication and business partnering: You communicate clearly and confidently in English with leadership and budget owners. You make complex financial topics easy to understand, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn insights into practical recommendations. You enjoy working closely with people across the business. Communication is a significant part of this role.

  • Strong FP&A ownership: You bring extensive FP&A experience (5+ years) and have independently run planning, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting, and can explain how your analysis informed business decisions.

  • Hands-on modelling skills: You build and maintain financial models and reports yourself, understand their underlying assumptions, and can connect operational drivers to financial outcomes.

  • SaaS, software, or tech experience: You understand the economics of a software business and can interpret the metrics that matter for its growth and performance.

  • Planning system ownership: You have owned a platform such as Abacum or a comparable planning tool, including developing models, improving workflows, and enabling stakeholders to use it.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You actively look for ways to improve recurring work and can judge where automation adds value and where human review is needed.

  • A broad Finance foundation: You understand how accounting, tax, and financial operations affect planning and reporting, and work effectively with specialists across these areas.

  • Proactive, reliable execution: You take ownership of deadlines, bring updates without being asked, and stay clear and organised when priorities compete. You are fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Exposure to board reporting or fundraising support.

  • Familiarity with Abacum, BigQuery, or connecting planning tools to accounting and operational data.

  • Another European language.

Who this role is for

You have seen what good FP&A looks like, and you are ready to build it in a business that is scaling fast. You enjoy creating the model, getting close to the business, and turning incomplete information into a recommendation people can act on.

You are comfortable taking ownership before everything is neatly defined. When inputs are missing, you bring the right people together. When assumptions do not hold up, you challenge them. When a process slows everyone down, you improve it. You can deliver the next forecast while building a better way to run the one after it.

At plancraft, that means shaping planning across growing European markets, making Abacum useful for budget owners, and putting AI and automation to work in everyday Finance. You will have room to make decisions, test better approaches, and see your work influence how we grow. That freedom comes with the expectation that you move things forward, communicate proactively, and follow through.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

description:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting.   • Develop and improve ML models for classification, retrieval, ranking and personalisation

  • Build evaluation pipelines, datasets and metrics to measure model quality and detect regressions

  • Monitor model performance, debug production issues and improve models based on evaluation results and user feedback

  • 3+ years of machine learning engineering experience, including deploying models to production

  • Strong Python programming skills and experience with PyTorch or JAX

  • Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, model training and evaluation

  • Experience with classification, ranking, retrieval, recommendation or personalisation models

  • Experience working with embeddings, vector search or information retrieval systems

  • Experience building data pipelines, training workflows and model inference services

  • Ability to evaluate model performance using relevant metrics and experimentation

  • Understanding of trade-offs between model accuracy, latency, computational cost and reliability

Nice to Have

  • Experience with transformer models, LLM fine-tuning or embedding models

  • Experience with recommendation systems or personalisation in consumer applications

  • Experience with large-scale ML training or inference infrastructure

About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will be responsible for building and running the operational infrastructure behind ActAI.

This includes setting up new offices and entities, implementing payroll and local operations, managing vendors, supporting recruiting operations, and ensuring the company can execute efficiently as it scales.

You will be responsible for operational execution across markets.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead business operations across multiple countries.

  • Manage and develop a team of Business Operations Partners.

  • Oversee office setup, entity incorporation, and market launches.

  • Oversee payroll implementation and local operational requirements.

  • Manage external vendors and service providers.

  • Support recruiting operations, recruiter onboarding, and hiring activities.

  • Plan and execute company events, offsites, and operational logistics.

  • Track key initiatives and ensure actions are completed on time.

  • Improve processes where needed to increase speed and reliability.

What You Will Need

  • Experience in business operations, strategic operations, founder's office, or similar roles.

  • Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.

  • Comfortable working across recruiting, finance, legal, and administrative functions.

  • Able to identify problems, make decisions, and drive execution independently.

  • High ownership and willingness to take responsibility for outcomes.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

The role
As an AI Engineer for Large-Scale Pre-Training, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the infrastructure we use to train large-scale robot foundation models on petabyte-scale datasets across our GPU fleet. This infrastructure is a critical part of our research and development cycle: it must strike the right balance between stability and velocity, enabling fast research iterations based on reliable results. This is a full-time, permanent position.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Scalable Training Infrastructure: Develop software infrastructure to train multi-billion-parameter robot foundation models efficiently on large video datasets across multi-node GPU clusters.

  • Data Pipelines: Build high-throughput, reliable data pipelines that stream, decode and preprocess petabyte-scale video datasets, keeping our GPUs fully utilized and supporting deterministic, resumable training.

  • Experiment Management: Build the tools to organize, monitor and optimize large training workloads and model sweeps. Remove bottlenecks in our training pipelines and make sure all our runs maintain the highest possible goodput.

Who we are looking for
We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together.

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience training multi-billion-parameter models on multi-node GPU clusters, including supervising long-running experiments, in-flight debugging and optimizing goodput and MFU.

you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. title: CRO Manager
description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a CRO Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Some our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • AB Tasty

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Senior HRBP
description:
Our vision
We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us
Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants
💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.
🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe
🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings
🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 7000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

🚀Job description

To support our scale, we are looking for an experienced HR Business Partner to join the People team. Reporting into our Lead HRBP, you will contribute at both hands-on and strategic levels, as a trusted partner to our teams and as a program manager to cultivate and develop a best-in-class employee experience.You act as a partner to our People team. You have strong decision-making skills with a thorough understanding of talent management and also organizational design within technology companies, to support our teams’ rapid growth. The HRBP will be responsible for supporting and executing all the projects and functions that will be designed by the HR Development Manager.

Your role will comprise of

HR Business Partnering
- You set up rituals with managers and team members to build relationships of trust and become the preferred contact for the teams.
- With a deep understanding of the population you support, you are the privileged HR point of contact to accompany teams at all steps of the employee life cycle (on-boarding, 3-month and 6-month feedback, performance assessment, compensation review, internal transfer, off-boarding…).
- You advise our people managers on organization design, individual performance review, promotions, compensation.
- You also advise our employees on learning & development opportunities, career pathing and evolution.
- You are the internal communication relay of your perimeter, you ensure a good respect of the rules in force in the company, and you contribute to the animation of new HR processes and of the company's culture in order to maximize retention.

Talent development
- You participate and establish projects related to the People team roadmap
- You will build and run rigorous data analysis and reporting solutions based on business needs, to inform on program or process impact measurements

The profile we are looking for :
- You have a strong experience in a similar position ; having worked in a fast-growing environment is a strong plus
- You have a well-rounded experience on a variety of HR-related topics: onboarding, learning & development, legal, compensation & benefits.
- You excel at creating trust and developing strong working relationships at all levels of an organization
- You demonstrate excellent writing and conversational communications skills in both French and English
- You know how to drive performance management in a fast growing company (+500 hires / year)
- You know how to drive and support your internal stakeholders in projects like designing organisations and anticipating future needs and stakes

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :
- To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
- To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
- Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity
- We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Recruitment Process

- First an interview with a Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)
- Interview with Charlène, Lead HRBP (45 min - 1h)
- Case Study at home and debriefing with Marine, VP People & Charlène (1h)
- Last round with Salomé (Lead Development) & Comex Member (30 min) + Fit interview with one or two team members (30 min)

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

title: Strategic Account Executive - Paris
Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)
description:
About Genesis

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

The role

General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too.

You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area.

You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently.

What you will do

  • Help lead the Paris data collection floor. Set the execution and quality bar for day-to-day collection work and help the team scale effectively.

  • Own complex collection setups. Take a loosely defined request and turn it into a working, repeatable collection task, including the setup, fixtures, props, environment, and procedure, with minimal support from engineering.

  • Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models.

  • Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data.

  • Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators.

  • Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy.

  • Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements.

  • Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar.

  • Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team.

  • Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues.

  • Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar.

What we are looking for

  • You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment.

  • Hands-on robot or glove-based data collection experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. This kind of data collection is new, and we will teach you our specific tools and approach.

  • You build, not just run. Give you a vague request and a scrappy setup, and you can turn it into a clean, repeatable task with the right fixtures, environment, process, and written procedure.

  • You can operate autonomously. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex collection tasks with limited day-to-day support from engineering.

  • You understand quality beyond collection. You can review your work, recognize when collected data is unusable or below the quality bar, and understand why.

  • You are ready to lead. You have trained, mentored, or led others doing hands-on work and want to help establish the execution and quality standard for a growing team.

  • You work well with research and engineering teams. You can translate their requests into physical collection tasks and turn what you observe during collection into useful feedback.

  • You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice the moment something about the setup, hardware, environment, procedure, or collected data is off.

  • You are technically handy. You are comfortable with Linux, some Python scripting to automate repetitive work, and hardware assembly and troubleshooting.

  • You are comfortable in a fast-moving environment. Hardware, processes, and collection methods will evolve quickly, and you are comfortable adapting while helping improve how the team works.

  • You communicate well in English. You will work daily with teams in Paris and the Bay Area across time zones. French is a plus.

  • Bonus: reliability testing. You have partnered with a reliability or test team on real-robot testing.

Working conditions and role constraints

  • Work takes place in production environments and technical laboratories.

  • Prolonged standing and repetitive hand and arm movements while wearing collection equipment, including gloves, head-mounted cameras, and headsets, for extended periods.

  • Handling and lifting of loads, including props, fixtures, robot equipment, and station equipment, up to 23 kg for station setup and reconfiguration.

Why this role

  • Real ownership. You will have meaningful ownership over how the Paris data collection floor operates and help set the standard the team grows toward.

  • Hands-on leadership. You will remain close to the work while helping guide other operators, improve execution, and raise the quality bar.

  • Build, not just execute. You will take ambiguous collection needs and turn them into reliable, repeatable tasks that can scale across the team.

  • A clear growth path. As the operation scales, this role can grow toward leading or supervising teams of operators or toward broader project and program management responsibilities.

  • The front line of the mission. The data you create, review, and improve is what teaches our robots to work.

You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.

title: Jr Account Executive
description:
About Us

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

  • Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

  • Create engaging ways to show our product

  • Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

  • Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

  • Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

  • Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

  • Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path


What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

  • Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

  • Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

  • Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

  • Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

  • A minimum of 1 year of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

  • You are comfortable working in both English and Dutch

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

Team mission

Marketplace Economics is a new team at GetYourGuide, built to answer the questions that determine how our marketplace grows and how it should be designed. How much revenue does the next euro of paid search actually return? Which marketing channels are genuinely incremental, and which are taking credit for demand we already had? What price should a supplier set, what does a change in commission do to supply, demand, and liquidity, and how should our ranking and supplier incentives be structured in the first place?

We are a senior team working directly with leadership across Marketing, Pricing, and Supply, among others, and the decisions we inform are among the largest the company makes. On the causal inference side, we draw on tools like experimental design, natural and quasi-experiments, double machine learning, synthetic controls, and more to inform marketing attribution and incrementality, spend allocation, and price elasticity. Our structural work models demand, supply, and the mechanisms connecting them, so we can reason about equilibrium outcomes and simulate counterfactuals we can't run as experiments. Most of our hardest problems in pricing and market design need both.

Your mission

You'll be a technical lead for pricing and supply and a core contributor to our marketplace measurement work. Reporting to the Director of Marketplace Economics, you will:

  • Own the economics of pricing end to end: estimate travel demand and willingness to pay, build the structural models that turn those estimates into defensible price recommendations for our supply partners, and run the experiments that validate them.

  • Work collaboratively with other economists on paid marketing optimization problems across channels and geographies and funnel stages.

  • Work on the design of the marketplace itself; commission and incentive structures, inventory coverage, supply liquidity.

  • Partner closely with business leads in Marketing, Pricing, and Supply by translating ambiguous commercial questions into reasonable identification strategies that drive meaningful business outcomes.

  • Set the technical bar for empirical rigor at GetYourGuide: raise the quality of experiment design across teams, mentor analysts and data scientists.

Your toolkit

  • PhD in Economics, or a closely related quantitative discipline with a strong applied focus.

  • 5+ years of applied work after your PhD, including 2+ years at a marketplace or platform company.

  • Comfort with structural work: discrete choice and demand estimation, equilibrium and counterfactual simulation, and the industrial organization or market design toolkit for reasoning about mechanisms, incentives, and two-sided platform dynamics.

  • Expertise in causal inference: experimental design, difference-in-differences, synthetic control, regression discontinuity, double/debiased ML, and Bayesian approaches to media measurement.

  • The judgment to choose between these approaches for the problem in front of you, and to say clearly what each one can and cannot support.

  • Strong Python and SQL, and comfort working with production-scale data alongside data engineers and scientists.

  • A track record of your analysis influencing business decisions.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for stakeholder work: excellent written and spoken English, and the judgment to know when a simpler answer is the right one.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Pricing, demand estimation, or revenue management experience in a two-sided marketplace.

  • Market or mechanism design work in production: matching, ranking, allocation, or incentive systems that real users transacted through.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

  • Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen.

description:

Birdsview ist die Agentic Sales Platform für den E-Commerce: KI-Agenten, die autonom verkaufen - per E-Mail und direkt im Shop. Vor allem dort, wo Kataloge komplex sind und gute Beratung den Unterschied macht.

Unsere Kunden - Online-Händler und Marken auf Shopware und Shopify, von LUSH über TeeGschwendner bis Egle - wechseln zu uns, weil unsere Agents sofort live sind, im Schnitt ein Vielfaches ihrer Kosten einspielen und 1:1-Personalisierung at scale liefern, während Incumbents wie Klaviyo manuelle Tools bleiben, die meist eine Agentur zum Betrieb brauchen.

Deine Mission

Die Rolle in einem Satz: Du bist das Gesicht von Birdsview für unsere Kunden, von Go-Live bis Renewal, und baust gleichzeitig die AI-Systeme, mit denen das ohne Ticket-Flut skaliert.

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Customer Success Manager, der Tickets abarbeitet. Unser zweiköpfiges Customer-Team betreut unsere Kunden bereits jeden Tag — was fehlt, ist das System dahinter: klare Prozesse, Automatisierung, ein durchgängiger Weg vom Vertragsabschluss bis zum Renewal. Mit den beiden arbeitest du jeden Tag eng zusammen, und genauso eng mit den Foundern: Ihr sitzt zusammen im Office, stimmt Prioritäten direkt ab, und du bekommst ungefilterten Einblick in Produkt, Vertrieb und Strategie.

Du übernimmst die End-to-End-Verantwortung für Ergebnisse und Systeme in diesem Bereich: Du bringst Kunden live auf Avys und Robyn, machst sie messbar erfolgreich, verantwortest Renewals & Expansion — und baust den Bereich so um, wie ein AI-Unternehmen ihn heute bauen sollte: automatisiert, skalierbar, AI-first. Am Ende beantwortet kein Mensch mehr First-Level-Anfragen — nicht, weil wir am Team sparen, sondern damit Menschen bei uns nur das tun, was Maschinen nicht können: Beziehungen, Eskalationen, Wachstum.

Das erwartet dich

  • Go-Live: Du onboardest neue Kunden auf unsere Agents — vom Kickoff über die Shop-Anbindung (Shopware/Shopify) bis zur ersten Mail von Avys und den ersten Empfehlungen von Robyn im Shop.

  • Success: Du bleibst nah an unseren Kunden, machst den ROI unserer Agents sichtbar und sorgst dafür, dass aus Go-Lives begeisterte Referenzen werden.

  • Growth: Du verantwortest Vertragsverlängerungen und Upsells auf neue Features und Produktlinien.

  • Systeme statt Tickets: Du baust den Customer-Bereich AI-first um — automatisiertes Onboarding, Health Scores, Self-Service, AI-gestützter Support (n8n, Claude, APIs). Ziel: Repetitive Anfragen erledigt die Maschine, dein Team hat den Rücken frei für alles, was echten Impact hat.

  • Voice of the Customer: Du ownst Eskalationen und übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Produktentscheidungen — mit direktem Draht zu Engineering und Foundern.

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Drive, Lernwille, Smartness: Das zählt für uns mehr als Jahre im Lebenslauf. Customer-Success-Erfahrung brauchst du nicht unbedingt — du kannst auch direkt nach dem Studium einsteigen. Die Founder arbeiten eng mit dir und bringen dich schnell auf Tempo.

  • People Person: Du hast echtes Interesse an Customer Success und an den Menschen hinter unseren Kunden. Du suchst den direkten Kontakt, am Telefon, im Call oder vor Ort, baust Vertrauen auf und machst Kunden zu Partnern.

  • Systems Thinking: Du automatisierst dich selbst aus repetitiver Arbeit heraus, bevor jemand danach fragt.

  • AI-native: LLMs sind dein Tagesgeschäft, du baust Workflows mit n8n, Make & Co., nutzt Tools wie Claude Cowork aktiv und hast keine Berührungsängste mit APIs und Webhooks.

Work Ethic

  • Velocity > Komfort: Du liebst es, wenn Dinge schnell passieren.

  • Figure-it-out-Mentality: Viele Prozesse existieren noch nicht — du baust sie.

  • Hard Work / High Reward: Du verstehst, dass ein Early-Stage-Startup kein 9-to-5 ist.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Monat 1: Du kennst jeden Kunden, das Team und jeden bestehenden Prozess — und dessen Lücken.

  • Monat 2: Die drei größten manuellen Prozesse laufen automatisiert.

description:
💡 Envie de construire des produits IA qui vont au-delà du POC ?

L'intelligence artificielle transforme les usages, mais le véritable défi reste de concevoir des solutions utiles, performantes et capables de passer à l'échelle.

Chez Hubvisory, nous accompagnons de grandes organisations dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux à forte valeur ajoutée.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Product Manager spécialisé(e) en IA pour imaginer, structurer et déployer des solutions innovantes, en combinant vision produit, compréhension technologique et impact business.

🎯 Ton rôle au quotidien

Tu interviendras sur des projets stratégiques, de l'identification des opportunités jusqu'au déploiement des solutions.

Tes principaux challenges :

  • Identifier les opportunités IA : comprendre les enjeux business et utilisateurs pour faire émerger des cas d'usage pertinents.

  • Définir la stratégie produit : construire et prioriser une roadmap cohérente, en intégrant les possibilités offertes par les LLM, le RAG et les agents IA.

  • Passer de l'expérimentation à l'industrialisation : évaluer la faisabilité, anticiper les contraintes et garantir la création de valeur.

  • Faire le lien entre métier et technologie : collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Engineering, Data et MLOps pour orienter les décisions produit.

  • Mesurer la performance : définir les bons indicateurs, suivre l'adoption et optimiser les solutions en continu.

  • Embarquer les parties prenantes : porter une vision claire, faciliter les arbitrages et accompagner le changement.

Tu auras l'occasion d'évoluer dans des environnements exigeants, auprès de références telles que LVMH, Sephora, TF1 ou l'Urssaf.


🔎 Le profil que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout un(e) Product Manager capable de connecter les enjeux business aux possibilités concrètes de l'intelligence artificielle.

Ce qui fera la différence :

  • Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en Product Management, avec une expérience concrète sur des produits IA ou fortement orientés data.

  • Les concepts de LLM, RAG, IA générative et systèmes agentiques te sont familiers.

  • Tu sais travailler avec des équipes techniques, comprendre les grands principes d'une architecture IA et participer aux arbitrages sans nécessairement coder.

  • Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux du Product Management : discovery, priorisation, delivery, KPI et OKR.

  • Tu sais prendre du recul, challenger les besoins et défendre tes convictions avec pragmatisme.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans des environnements complexes, avec des interlocuteurs variés.

  • Tu communiques avec aisance en français comme en anglais.

Ton état d'esprit ? Curieux(se), analytique, autonome et toujours à l'affût des évolutions de l'écosystème IA.

✨ Ce que tu trouveras chez Hubvisory

Rejoindre Hubvisory, c'est intégrer une communauté de passionnés du Product, où l'expertise se partage et où chacun peut continuer à progresser.

Au programme :

  • 🎓 Un onboarding de 2 semaines au sein de notre Campus pour approfondir tes compétences Product.

  • 🧠 Une communauté d'experts avec des rendez-vous réguliers pour partager retours d'expérience, méthodes et nouvelles pratiques.

  • 📈 Une évolution accompagnée, avec des revues salariales deux fois par an.

  • 🎁 Des avantages complémentaires : intéressement et jours de congés supplémentaires.

  • 🎉 Une vraie vie d'équipe : événements, séminaires, activités et moments de convivialité.

  • 💎 Une culture fondée sur cinq piliers : bienveillance, ambition, expertise, apprentissage et méritocratie.

46 000 à 58 000 € brut annuel fixe, selon expérience, auxquels s'ajoutent une rémunération variable et un dispositif d'intéressement.

🤝 Comment se déroule le recrutement ?

Un processus structuré pour apprendre à se connaître et se projeter ensemble :

  1. Premier échange RH avec Caroline : ton parcours, tes motivations et tes attentes.

  2. Mise en situation Product : un cas pratique de 90 minutes avec un manager produit.

  3. Rencontre avec le leadership : 90 minutes d'échange avec un VP ou cofondateur dans les locaux.

  4. Dernier échange et proposition : alignement final et discussion autour du package.

Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour sous 7 jours maximum à chaque étape.

Si tu veux travailler sur des produits IA concrets, relever des défis complexes et évoluer aux côtés d'une communauté d'experts, on serait ravis d'échanger avec toi !

title: Location Data engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

  • Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A).

We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year:

title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
description:
As our Software Test Engineer at machineMD in Bern, you’ll bring your engineering skills to a practical challenge: making complex systems easier to test. You’ll design and build test automation, connect tools and technologies, and explore how agentic workflows can improve the way we work. Our existing infrastructure gives you a starting point, with the freedom to extend it and introduce new approaches. You’ll work alongside developers, requirements engineers, and testers, taking responsibility for solutions from design to daily use.

About machineMD

We’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere.

The Role

You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. You’ll design and build the test systems, agentic workflows, and tooling that make complex behaviour reproducible and failures easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.

  • Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.

  • Engineer the Next Generation of Test Automation – build intelligent, agent-powered systems that redefine how complex software is tested. Go beyond UI testing, architect autonomous workflows, experiment with cutting-edge AI technologies, and turn bold ideas into production-ready solutions. Own the test automation stack. Build, break, innovate.

  • Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.

  • Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.

  • Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.

What We Look For

Experience

  • Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.

  • Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.

  • Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is a plus.

  • Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.

Qualifications

  • Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.

  • Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.

  • Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration.

Eligibility to work in Switzerland (Swiss/EU/EFTA work permit).

How You Work

  • Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. You choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.

  • Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.

  • Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn and lend a hand.

  • Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.

  • Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases.

Working at machineMD

Located in Bern, Switzerland, we thrive on collaborative, in-person energy, while offering the flexibility you need to do your best work.

Available for roughly 80% of your time on-site in Bern and committed to our weekly anchor day on Monday.

We are united by the Four Pillars of Integrity: Radical Responsibility, Feeling Our Feelings, Candor and Clear Agreements. These are not just words on a wall; they guide how we:

  • Own our choices (Radical Responsibility)

  • Name and honour our emotions (Feeling Our Feelings)

  • Speak and listen with honesty (Candor)

  • Make and keep clear commitments (Clear Agreements)

Living these principles keeps us “whole”, fully alive, and brimming with the energy needed to build world-class diagnostic tools.

Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics at the frontlines in a dynamic startup environment, let’s talk!

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why.

We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only. No recruiters, please.

We’re excited to meet you!

title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments
