Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support geef je richting aan onze werkplekdienstverlening: van Microsoft 365 en randapparatuur tot support en servicedesk. Je bepaalt de roadmap, brengt focus aan en zorgt samen met het team en onze leveranciers dat we sneller, voorspelbaarder en met een betere gebruikerservaring leveren. 

Wie ben jij

Je bent iemand die verder kijkt dan de eerstvolgende sprint. Je kunt zelfstandig een visie en roadmap ontwikkelen, brengt focus aan en durft keuzes te maken wanneer belangen uiteenlopen.

 
Daarbij hoef je niet jarenlang de formele titel Product Owner te hebben gehad. We vinden het belangrijker dat je aantoonbaar eigenaarschap hebt genomen over een IT-product of -dienst en gewend bent om daarin richting en prioriteiten te bepalen. Je krijgt in deze rol veel ruimte. Je stelt zelf de roadmap op, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en stuurt op verbeteringen binnen Werkplek & Support. Die autonomie betekent niet dat je alles alleen doet. Je stemt keuzes af het team, Servicemanager en teammanager zodat je elkaar kunt challengen op de juiste prioriteiten.

 
Het team bestaat uit collega's die al langere tijd bij Univé werken én collega's die relatief nieuw zijn. Het team heeft behoefte aan iemand die vanuit de Product Owner-rol richting en focus kan geven, zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn.

 
Onze werkplek is sterk gebaseerd op Microsoft 365, maar omvat meer dan alleen de digitale werkplek. Denk ook aan randapparatuur, lokale ondersteuning en supportdienstverlening. Je hoeft niet zelf de technisch specialist te zijn. Wel begrijp je moderne werkplekdienstverlening voldoende om een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn voor engineers, architecten, securityspecialisten en leveranciers.

 
Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is de operationele samenwerking met onze externe servicedesk en andere leveranciers. Samen met het team geef je richting aan prioriteiten en verbeteringen en zorg je dat ontwikkelingen binnen Werkplek & Support goed aansluiten op de ondersteuning van onze medewerkers.


Je voelt je daarnaast thuis in een omgeving die verandert. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie te stellen, kunt omgaan met weerstand en neemt stakeholders mee wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat.

Wat ga je doen

Wat breng je mee?
Voor ons is niet je exacte functietitel of het aantal jaren ervaring doorslaggevend. We willen vooral zien dat je dit soort verantwoordelijkheid eerder succesvol hebt gedragen.

•    Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het bepalen van visie, roadmap en prioriteiten voor een IT-product of IT- dienst;   

Je kunt verschillende belangen afwegen en duidelijke besluiten nemen en onderbouwen;
•    Je kunt vanuit een Product Owner-rol richting en focus geven aan een team zonder formeel leidinggevende te zijn;
•    Je bent sterk in stakeholder- en relatiemanagement en krijgt engineers, gebruikers, management en leveranciers mee;
•    Je hebt ervaring met externe IT-dienstverleners en weet in operationele samenwerking, samen met het team, verbeteringen te realiseren;
•    Je begrijpt werkplekdienstverlening en IT om inhoudelijk een stevige gesprekspartner te zijn;
•    Je hebt ervaring met het verbeteren van dienstverlening en kunt sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid en klantbeleving;
•    Je kunt omgaan met weerstand, bestaande werkwijzen ter discussie stellen en koers houden wanneer nog niet alles duidelijk is;
•    Je beschikt over hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met Microsoft 365 is welkom, maar diepgaande technische expertise is niet noodzakelijk. Ervaring met grotere transities of het insourcen van IT-dienstverlening is een pré.

Als Product Owner Werkplek & Support ben je verantwoordelijk voor de visie, roadmap en prioritering van onze werkplek- en supportdienstverlening.

Daarbij staat één vraag centraal: hoe zorgen we dat onze collega's prettig, veilig en efficiënt kunnen werken én snel en goed geholpen worden wanneer ondersteuning nodig is?

We willen vooral sneller en voorspelbaarder worden in wat we leveren en tegelijkertijd de gebruikerstevredenheid verder verhogen. Jij vertaalt die ambitie naar concrete keuzes en verbeteringen.

 
•    ontwikkelen en onderhouden van de visie, roadmap en backlog voor Werkplek & Support;
•    prioriteren van ontwikkelingen, incidenten en structurele verbeteringen;
•    vertalen van IT-doelstellingen en behoeften van medewerkers naar concrete prioriteiten;
•    richting geven aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Microsoft 365-gerichte werkplek, randapparatuur en ondersteunende dienstverlening;
•    sturen op snelheid, voorspelbaarheid, kwaliteit en gebruikerstevredenheid;
•    onderhouden van nauw contact met stakeholders, waaronder Regionale Univé's en decentrale beheerders, en hen meenemen in keuzes en veranderingen;
•    afstemmen met engineers, architecten, security, servicemanagement, leveranciers en andere IT-teams;
•    samen met het team operationeel aansturen van de externe servicedesk en andere relevante leveranciers en verbeteringen realiseren;
•    signalen en terugkerende vragen vanuit Support gebruiken om de werkplek structureel te verbeteren;
•    richting geven aan lifecyclemanagement, upgrades, migraties en vernieuwingen van de werkplek en randapparatuur;
•    kansen rond onder andere automatisering, selfservice en AI vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen;
•    organiseren en voorbereiden van Scrum-activiteiten binnen het team, waaronder sprintplanning, reviews en retrospectives.
 

Je krijgt daarbij ruimte om zelfstandig richting te geven. Dat betekent ook dat we verwachten dat je bestaande keuzes kritisch bevraagt en de teammanager durft te challengen wanneer jij denkt dat het beter kan.

Wat bieden wij

Je krijgt een functie binnen IT Kern Services voor 36–40 uur per week met veel ruimte om zelf richting te geven. Werkplek & Support wordt dagelijks door duizenden collega's gebruikt. De keuzes die jij maakt zijn dus direct merkbaar in de organisatie.

Ontwikkeling vinden we bij Univé belangrijk. Dat geldt voor de dienstverlening waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent, maar ook voor jezelf.

Het team werkt hybride vanuit Zwolle en Assen. Er is één vaste teamdag per week, afwisselend in Zwolle en Assen. De overige dagen werk je veelal vanuit je standplaats of thuis.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dichtbij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie.

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé. 


IT Kern levert het IT-fundament waarmee Univé haar doelen kan realiseren. Binnen IT Kern richt Services zich onder andere op werkplekdiensten, eerstelijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.
Binnen Werkplek & Support werk je samen met functioneel beheerders, IT-specialisten en een Business Informatie Analist. De servicedesk en het lokale beheer in Zwolle en Assen worden momenteel geleverd door een externe partner.
Je komt terecht in een team met verschillende achtergronden en ervaringsniveaus, binnen een organisatie met veel verschillende belangen en afhankelijkheden. Dat maakt de omgeving soms complex, maar geeft je als Product Owner ook veel ruimte om verbinding te leggen en zichtbaar verschil te maken.

title: Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een  uitdagende baan  in de wereld van de lucht- en ruimtevaart?

En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen?  Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren.

Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden.

Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica;

  • Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring;

  • Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden;

  • De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie;

  • Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie;

  • Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten;

  • In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact;

  • Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht;

  • Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau)

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen:

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoeksprogramma’s of om te bewijzen dat we radicale en nieuwe concepten op een veilige manier effectiever en sneller kunnen certificeren. We zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor modificaties aan onze research vliegtuigen en bewijzen dat deze veilig zijn.

We zijn georganiseerd in twee marktgeoriënteerde teams, Flight Test Support en Certification Support. Veel collega’s zijn in beide teams actief en werken vaak buiten de afdeling in multi-disciplinair verband. Er worden goede mogelijkheden geboden om je eigen ontwikkeling vorm te geven.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

title: Integration Test Engineer
description:
Role - Integration Test Engineer

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht

About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. 

We are a fast-growing international team of driven and collaborative talents, from engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact: iwell is committed to form a diverse and inclusive team to tackle the challenges of the energy transition.  

The Role

The proof is in the pudding, they say in the UK, however, we believe proof is in the test data. All our systems and their interactions within the larger energy ecosystem are thoroughly tested. We are serving a diverse customer base with strict demands, our services power business and key infrastructure. We demand that our products are subjected to a wide range of testing during the integration and development phase. We're seeking a talented and curious test engineer with a passion for sustainability and battery energy storage. 

You will handle a wide variety of topics from different customer requirements and have a lot of freedom to develop the test methodology and strategy. You will work within the battery system team, where software and hardware come together in the products we develop for our customers.  We will rely on your experience, hands-on approach and judgment. You will be crucial in driving our mission of transitioning from fossil-fuel dependence. If you're passionate about sustainability and have the technical skills to bring our vision to life, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

  • Develop test campaigns based on internal and external requirements

  • Discuss and present test results internally and externally

  • Execute tests and document the result

  • Support the integration of hardware components into iwell’s BESS, ensuring compatibility and performance.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, such as system specifications,  processes, and instructions.

  • You will become one of the practical system experts within iwell, interacting with field service, product development and engineering teams.

What are looking for

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in electrical design of high power and energy conversion systems.

  • Knowledge of technical standards and grid operator connection requirements.

  • Able to make the basic design for a site with energy production and storage, feeding into the Medium Voltage AC grid, including cable system design, PE system design and according to national installation guidelines.

  • Strong communication skills and attention to quality assurance

  • Ability to read and produce technical drawings and schematics

  • Ability to speak and write German is a plus

Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary within the range of EUR 5,200 - 5,800 (plus 8% holiday allowance)

  • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

  • The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year

  • Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year 

  • Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day 

  • Working remotely for 2 weeks per year 

  • We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport.

  • A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month

  • Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc.

  • iwell is a family friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities

Interested?

For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/. 

Our application process

  1. Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks.

  2. Phone screening. Are you an iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call.

  3. Are you the one? You will have two or more interviews. For some roles, you will also be asked to work on a case.

title: Data Platform Engineer

At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog. It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company.

Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt, Airflow, S3, AWS, Superset, and GitHub Actions. We ingest data from 30+ distinct external sources, process over 2.5 PB of data, and deliver most data marts to business consumers with a 1-hour end-to-end latency - a standard that demands highly optimized, rock-solid transformation pipelines.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  1. DWH Platform Development

    • Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.

    • Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.

    • Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.

  2. Team contributions

    • Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.

    • Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.

    • Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.

    • Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.

    • Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.

  3. Data modeling

    • Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices.

    • Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

    • Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.

  • Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment — exciting and dynamic, but sometimes wonderfully chaotic.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with ClickHouse - a significant advantage.

  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD development, especially using GitHub Actions.

title: Customer Support Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

In dieser Rolle bist du oft der erste und wichtigste Kontaktpunkt für unsere Kund:innen. Du verantwortest die Bearbeitung von Support-Tickets und Live-Chat-Anfragen, hilfst Unternehmen dabei, Probleme schnell und lösungsorientiert zu lösen und sorgst für eine starke Customer Experience. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Teams wie Product, Engineering und Customer Success zusammen und bringst wertvolles Feedback direkt aus dem Kundenkontakt zurück ins Unternehmen. Wenn du Lust auf ein dynamisches Umfeld, viel Eigenverantwortung und direkten Impact auf unsere Kund:innen hast, könnte das perfekt zu dir passen.

Who We Want

Customer-first operator. Du denkst aus Sicht der Kund:innen, übernimmst Verantwortung für Probleme und möchtest echte Lösungen schaffen - nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten.

Calm under pressure. Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig passiert, behältst du den Überblick, priorisierst sinnvoll und kommunizierst klar und professionell.

Customer-obsessed and empathetic. Du kannst komplexe Themen verständlich erklären, gehst geduldig auf unterschiedliche Kund:innen ein und sorgst für eine starke Customer Experience.

Collaborative and cross-functional. Du arbeitest eng mit Support, Product, Sales und Customer Success zusammen und verstehst, dass guter Support immer Teamarbeit ist.

Product-minded and analytical. Du möchtest verstehen, warum Probleme entstehen, erkennst Muster im Kundenfeedback und bringst aktiv Verbesserungsvorschläge ein.

Tech-curious and hands-on. Du hast Lust, dich technisch einzuarbeiten, Dinge selbst auszuprobieren und Probleme pragmatisch zu lösen, statt sie direkt weiterzugeben.

Who We Don’t Want

Escalates instead of thinking it through.
Du eskalierst jedes Problem sofort, statt selbst mitzudenken, zu analysieren und Lösungen zu finden.

Struggles in fast-paced environments.
Du tust dich in schnelllebigen Startup- oder SMB-Umfeldern schwer und verwaltest Probleme lieber, statt sie pragmatisch zu lösen.

Low ownership on difficult cases.
Du gibst Verantwortung bei schwierigen Fällen oder Eskalationen lieber ab, statt sie zu übernehmen.

Focused on tickets, not outcomes.
Du fokussierst dich stärker auf Ticket-Status und Prozesse als auf echte Kundenergebnisse und eine starke Customer Experience.

Copy-pastes standard answers.
Du greifst auf Standardantworten zurück, statt Kund:innen individuell und lösungsorientiert zu helfen.

Your Day To Day

Operational & Customer Contact (ca. 80%)

  • Du bist eine zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen im Live-Chat und hilfst ihnen dabei, Herausforderungen schnell und pragmatisch zu lösen. Deinen Tag startest du gemeinsam mit dem Team um 9:00 Uhr beim Daily Check-in, bevor du ab 10:00 Uhr die Betreuung unserer Kund:innen im Live-Chat übernimmst.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams zusammen, um komplexe Supportfälle effizient zu eskalieren und eine starke Customer Experience sicherzustellen.
  • Du unterstützt Kund:innen aus verschiedensten Branchen und Märkten dabei, Superchat erfolgreich und reibungslos zu nutzen.

Process Optimisation & Feedback (ca. 20%)

  • Du kollaborierst mit verschiedenen Abteilungen wie Sales, Product und Success, um Support-Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern und weiter aufzubauen
  • Du identifizierst aus Kundenfeedback Produktverbesserungen und priorisierst diese mit dem Produktteam
  • Du arbeitest aktiv am Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres AI-gestützten Support-Bots mit, um unsere Customer Experience effizienter und skalierbarer zu gestalten

Stakeholders

Kund:innen: deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe im täglichen Austausch
Customer Support Team: für Eskalationen, Troubleshooting und gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch
Product & Engineering: bei Bugs, technischen Sonderfällen und Produktfeedback aus dem direkten Kundenkontakt
Customer Success: für onboardingbezogene Support-Themen und die Koordination gemeinsamer Kund:innen
Sales: für relevanten Kundenkontext und Übergaben bei Bedarf

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
  • Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit
  • Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln
  • Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu
  • Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - wenig Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture

  • Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo
  • Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Jährliches Budget für persönliche Weiterbildung in Höhe von 500 € für zum Beispiel Konferenzen, Kurse, Bücher, Karrierecoach usw.
  • Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht
  • Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung

We want to build a community, not just a company.

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d)

Remote in Germany, Austria, Spain, Portugal, Italy, the Netherlands or the UK · Full-time · Engineering, Interoperability team

About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What to expect as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

Hospital staff still spend hours typing the same patient data into different systems. Our in-house RPA tool ends that: it automates hospital information systems (HIS) on Windows desktops so our data lands in patient forms automatically. We don't use UiPath or Blue Prism. We build our own engine in TypeScript, on Electron and Node with native Windows bindings.

You'll join the Interoperability team as a hands-on engineer. Your main focus is the engine itself; everything else builds on it.

  • You build, extend and stabilize the core of our RPA engine.

  • You make automations reliable in hospital environments we don't fully control, with remote updates and failure monitoring.

  • You automate HIS applications on Windows, including the hard legacy cases: UI Automation, Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or the browser where the app runs locally.

  • You solve the Citrix problem. Most hospitals serve their HIS through Citrix, where all we see is pixels, so you work with OCR, image anchors, mouse and keyboard input, and the redraw, scrolling and display-scaling issues that come with them.

  • You help extend the engine with new capabilities such as document extraction and voice input.

  • You set up the rollout process with our implementation team: installers, code signing and autostart in locked-down hospital IT, and fixing problems on machines you can't log into.

  • You protect health data by applying security best practices and complying with privacy regulations.


Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):

  • You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience and have built automation software that runs in production, not only configured bots in an RPA product.

  • You write strong TypeScript or similar

  • You have automated Windows desktop applications with UI Automation, plus at least one of Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or browser automation over CDP, and native interop (Node native addons, C# or C++).

  • You have experience with image-based automation over Citrix or RDP (OCR, screen anchors), or a strong wish to learn it. UiPath or Blue Prism developers with Citrix or computer-vision experience who now want to build the engine are very welcome.

  • You know how to keep automations reliable in production: monitoring, failure handling, updates, and testing against apps you can't run in CI.

  • You communicate clearly in English with technical and non-technical people, and you're comfortable working with German-language software.

  • You analyze problems thoroughly and drive them to resolution.

  • Nice to have: experience with OCR, document extraction or speech-to-text; healthcare or HIS integration experience; knowledge of GDPR and sensitive data; spoken German, which helps during rollout with hospital IT.

Not a perfect match on every point? We care more about shared drive and a real sense of mission than about ticking every box.

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You will own products from the first conversation about a problem to the moment customers use them, and keep improving them after launch. That means figuring out what matters, cutting the scope to something useful, designing the experience and API, building across the stack, and taking responsibility for how it works in production.

You will own clearing products for Global Banks and Financial Institutions such as big Banks in Mexiko, fintechs in Nigeria or Central Banks in Southeast Asia. This could be anything across accounts, payments, treasury, credit, FX, multi-currency, our public APIs or the dashboard. You will own products and features end to end, meaning from working with a customer to shipping something to have impact.

We expect you to combine incredible bias to AI with great technical taste and hard work. Own problems, build products, ship value. At all times, you are responsible for the code you write, so you must be able to write, understand and debug code. Fast implementation only matters when the product solves the right problem and works reliably.

This is a demanding role with substantial ownership. You will learn unfamiliar domains quickly, make decisions with incomplete information and put sustained effort into getting difficult things over the line. You will have a lot of say about how you design features and how our product looks like.

Your First Six Months

  • Weeks 1-2: Ship one big feature to a customer with taste.

  • Months 1-3: Launch one new product to customers.

  • Months 4-6: Own and iteratively improve one product.

  • Months 7-12: Own and launch new products. Build an enablement system for agents around launching the products you own.

 

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You see an awkward workflow and start figuring out how to make it better. You can show us something you took from an idea to a working product, and explain the decisions you made.

  • You learn unfamiliar systems quickly. You ask precise questions, find the underlying constraints and change your mind when the evidence changes.

  • You care a LOT about product experience: API naming, sensible defaults, loading states, clear errors and what happens when something fails.

  • You use agents to attempt more ambitious work. You can show how you steer them, catch their mistakes and verify the result.

  • You move quickly and work hard. When a project gets difficult, you narrow the problem, seek help where needed and keep ownership until it works.

  • You can choose the smallest useful solution and still insist on correctness, security and a good user experience.

  • You want responsibility that grows with your ability. Your strongest evidence might come from a startup, a job, open-source work or something you built independently.

This is not for you if:

  • You need others to get your stuff done.

  • You do not enjoy talking to customers.

  • You vibe code stuff without adding quality gates and correctness checks.

  • You treat product decisions as someone else's responsibility.

  • You are not able to pick up new complex domains quickly.

  • You do not enjoy working long hours.

Hard Requirements

Must Haves:

  • At least one working product or substantial feature you personally built and can discuss in depth. Commercial, independent and open-source work all count; confidential work can be discussed without sharing private code.

  • Hands-on use of coding agents, including the ability to review their output and identify incorrect or unsafe behavior.

  • Based in Berlin or open to relocate.

Strong preference:

  • Experience shipping a product with real users and improving it from feedback.

  • Evidence of unusually strong independent work: a useful side project, meaningful open-source contributions, a company you built or substantial ownership in a small team.

  • Experience with APIs, payments or financial products. Banking experience is useful, but not required.

  • There is no minimum number of years of experience or degree requirement. We assess demonstrated ability and scope of ownership.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €70,000-€100,000 + equity and benefits.

What We Offer

title: Research Engineer - Robotics RL & Post Training
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

What you will work on

  • Train and refine RL policies for contact-rich manipulation, including precise assembly, insertion, and recovery from failures.

  • Develop rewards, curricula, and reset strategies for efficient policy learning.

  • Distill specialist capabilities into generalist policies through expert-generated data, imitation learning, and teacher–student methods.

  • Investigate direct RL post-training of vision-language-action models and world-action models.

  • Build data collection, filtering, sampling, and augmentation pipelines using demonstrations, autonomous rollouts, and human corrections.

  • Build scientifically sound evaluation pipelines across simulation and real robots, measuring success, precision, speed, robustness, and recovery.

  • Design controlled experiments and ablations that isolate the effects of algorithms, data, model changes, and training budgets.

  • Diagnose and reduce sim-to-real gaps in dynamics, sensing, timing, and control.

  • Build reliable, maintainable training and evaluation software with reproducible configurations, versioned data, and traceable results.

    What we are looking for

  • Strong practical experience implementing and debugging reinforcement learning for continuous control, ideally robotic manipulation.

  • Experience with imitation learning and policy distillation or teacher–student training.

  • Strong working knowledge of ML/DL fundamentals

  • Strong software engineering skills: clear interfaces, maintainable code, meaningful tests, systematic debugging, and reliable experiment infrastructure.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch or JAX skills, with the ability to own work from research implementation through real-robot evaluation.

  • Experience designing rigorous evaluation protocols: meaningful baselines, held-out test conditions, leakage prevention, repeated trials, and appropriate uncertainty estimates.

  • First-principles thinking: the ability to question assumptions, identify underlying mechanisms, and distinguish causal evidence from correlation.

  • Experience with sim-to-real transfer and a robotics simulation stack such as MuJoCo or Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab.

  • Evidence of substantial research contributions through publications at venues such as CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR, or equivalent demonstrated research and engineering work.

    Especially relevant experience

  • RL post-training of pretrained VLAs or WAMs.

  • Distilling multiple specialists into a shared generalist while preserving existing capabilities.

  • Visual RL, privileged-information teachers, and contact-rich manipulation.

  • Offline and online RL, human-in-the-loop learning, and learning from failures.

  • Diffusion or flow-matching action policies and temporally chunked actions.

  • Distributed training and large-scale rollout collection.

    What success looks like

    Reproducible improvements in real-robot performance, supported by controlled experiments that explain what helped, where it generalizes, and where it still fails.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

Equal Opportunity

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely.

The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists.

Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios.

  • Build the pipelines and infrastructure that generate synthetic cybersecurity training instances at scale — thousands of scenarios, not one hand-crafted exercise.

  • Conduct experiments and evaluations of model capabilities on these environments, from quick prototypes to controlled benchmark runs.

  • Own the infrastructure behind the environments: containers, sandboxes, VMs, cloud deployments, and orchestration (Kubernetes), all managed as code.

  • Partner with researchers and security specialists across Mistral, distilling their domain expertise into reproducible environments and datasets.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering skills: clean, reliable, well-tested code — not just exploit scripts.

  • Fluency in Python plus comfort reading lower-level languages (C/C++) for vulnerability analysis.

  • DevOps experience: Docker, Kubernetes, cloud deployments, sandboxed or simulated environments.

  • A pragmatic research-to-engineering mindset: ship a working first version, then refine and scale it.

  • Working knowledge of RL techniques and LLM training methodologies, or strong motivation to develop it.

Nice-to-haves

  • CTF, cyber-range, or bug-bounty experience — as a player, challenge author, or platform builder.

  • Prior experience building RL environments or large-scale ML training infrastructure.

description:

So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money.

Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries.

What we build

    • Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers.
    • Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys.
    • Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data.
    • Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded.
Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business.
 

The 5 values we work by

    • Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent.
    • Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure.
    • Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem.
    • Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate.
    • No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble.
We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners.

Context 📄

How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell?

As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market.

Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys.

Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. The FP&A team is being reorganised into an end-to-end function of 4 people, including the Head of FP&A. Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Head of FP&A leads the newly structured FP&A function (a team of 3 FP&A controllers). This role comes at a pivotal moment: Younited is moving to a market-standard, end-to-end FP&A organization and the Head of FP&A will be responsible for shaping his/her team target operating model, formalise scopes and ways of working, and progressively automate and strengthen the reliability of the whole planning and reporting chain — while partnering closely with the business to turn financial analysis into better decisions.

  • Build the team target operating model, define the set of FP&A procedures (scopes, calendar, controls, documentation) and make its organisation resilient by design with clear back-ups and shared standards.

  • Own the monthly closing process: pre-close anticipation of closing topics so that issues are spotted before the accounts are closed, post-close analysis of variances to budget, and capital plan.
  • Deliver timely, clear financial reporting tailored to each audience — leadership, local management and business partners — including management accounts, variance analyses and ad hoc studies, and act as a business partner to the divisions on strategic initiatives and performance improvement.
  • Lead, develop and coach the FP&A team, ensuring skills development, back-up and high performance across the scope.

    • with a good understanding of a market standard full management cycle — budgeting, multi-year business planning, forecasting and management reporting,

description:

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.

You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

  • 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

  • Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

  • The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

  • Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

  • You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

  • You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

  • 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

  • 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

  • You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

  • You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

  • You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

  • You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

  • You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

  • Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply.

What is hard

  • Our brand is smaller than the labs'. You will win on what Dust does next to the assistant a group already chose, not on our name.

  • Large groups move slowly and decide at the top. A unit that loves the product does not make a group deal; you will learn to find the person who does.

  • The playbook is unfinished. You will be writing it while you use it.

What you get

  • OTE €180k OTE 50/50 split, uncapped accelerators, and a significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed company.

  • Founders on your accounts, a small team that decides fast, and room to lead as the Strategic team grows. We are not promising a title; we will look here first when we need one.

  • Health cover, relocation support, Paris office, regular trips to San Francisco.

How we hire

A call with Talent, a deep dive on your largest deals with the hiring manager, a live executive meeting role-play, then a half-day where you present an account plan for a group of your choice, and a conversation with a founder. We decide within [2–3] weeks of your first call.

description:

About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

Support has grown into one of our core services — service-agreement clients, our AI Support Agent, and on-demand project management. We’re looking for one person to own it end-to-end: the vision, the processes, the quality, the team and the commercials — and to push how far we can take AI in support. You turn a growing, multi-part operation into one well-led, measurable, continuously improving service.

How we work

You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class support to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we’re AI-first: we automate the repetitive parts and use AI as a core tool every day, so the team can focus on judgement and quality.


What you’ll do

  • Own Support end-to-end — set the vision, priorities and best practices, and give the function clear direction.

  • Run and level up our processes and AI — continuously improve all support processes, including our AI Support Agent; keep them documented, train the team, own security & compliance.

  • Lead the team — empower Support Managers, WordPress developers, the on-demand PM and specialists; strong ticket and incident management and a culture of continuous learning.

  • Drive quality and delivery — define and track SA quality and delivery metrics (client satisfaction, return rate, response and completion times) and report to management.

  • Be a trusted partner to key SA clients — foster up- and cross-selling and act as relationship manager; you think about their business, not just their tickets.

  • Keep an eye on budget and profitability — invoicing, contribution margin and cost-saving measures, with support from our finance team.

  • Handle continuity and crises — prepare for and manage outages and security incidents calmly.

Key & Essential Skills

  • Ideally 5+ years in support, service delivery or technical account management (digital/web agency or hosting/WordPress environment), including experience leading a small team.

  • Solid technical grasp of WordPress, hosting and uptime/security monitoring — you don’t code, but you speak the language and can steer technical work.

  • A strong process thinker genuinely excited to take our use of AI in support to the next level.

  • Commercial sense — comfortable with invoicing, budgets and contribution margin.

  • Fluent English (our working language); German is a plus but not required.

  • Comfortable with written-only communication (tickets, email, chat); this role has no phone support.

What makes you a fit

  • You take ownership and see things through.

  • You stay calm and structured under pressure — incidents and outages don’t rattle you.

  • You give honest feedback, to clients and to us.

  • You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward.

Perks

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere. (Our Seefeld office in Zurich is there if you’re local.)

  • Real responsibility and influence — and a team that has your back. See something to improve? Speak up, we’re listening.

  • Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy — results-oriented, no micromanaging.

  • A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities — e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins’ UPW event.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

  • Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

  • Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

  • Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

  • Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

  • Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

  • Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

  • Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

  • Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.

title: Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics)
description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

When a drone fails a test on our production floor, you're the first person we call. As Production Quality Control Specialist (Software/Electronics), you're the first line of technical support for production. You troubleshoot, diagnose and fix failures across our VTOL drones, their sub-systems, sensors and in-process quality tests. That way every aircraft we ship meets the standard our customers rely on in the field.

You also step back from single failures and look at the data. You analyze yields and quarantine trends, find the root causes behind repeat problems and decide which fixes to tackle first. You work closely with Production, Engineering and Supply Chain, and your work shows up directly in product quality and output.



 


Responsibilities

  • First on the scene. You're the first-line technical support for production issues, from test failures and assembly defects to nonconforming units.

  • Fix what's broken. You troubleshoot and repair electrical, electronic and system-level failures on drones, sub-assemblies, payloads and sensors.

  • Keep the test benches honest. You help investigate issues with our software and electronics test benches.

  • Decide what happens to quarantined material. You choose whether it gets reworked, repaired, scrapped or returned to the supplier.

  • Find the real cause. You lead root cause analyses (5 Whys, Ishikawa, 8D) on recurring and high-impact failures.

  • Let the data point the way. You analyze yields and quarantine Paretos to spot the biggest quality drivers.

  • See fixes through. You turn your findings into prioritized corrective actions (CAPA) and follow them until they are closed.

  • Keep failure, test and repair records traceable.

  • Share what you learn. You feed findings back to Engineering and suppliers, and you train assembly staff on failure modes and workmanship defects.


    • Requirements

  • You've spent 4+ years as a quality technician, quality inspector or assembly technician on a complex mechatronic product.

  • You understand at system level how mechanics, electronics, sensors and firmware work together.

  • You're at ease with data. You can build yield and failure Paretos and draw sound conclusions from them.

  • You're motivated and able to get to know our test software stack.

  • You're methodical and keep good records, and you make sound calls under production pressure.

  • You have a technical apprenticeship or technical diploma in Engineering, Manufacturing or Mechatronics, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You communicate excellently in English and enjoy working together on the shop floor.


    • Plus

  • Experience with UAVs, RC aircraft or avionics

  • Familiarity with batteries, GNSS, IMUs, cameras or LiDAR

  • Experience designing electronics PCBAs

  • Experience in software programming

  • SPC, Cp/Cpk, MSA or a Six Sigma Green Belt

title: Research Engineer
description:
Do you believe the path to general-purpose physical AI runs through noisy, real-world factory deployments?
Are you excited by the challenge of turning the classical robotic stacks into the foundational training data for physical AI?
Do you want to bridge the gap between world-class ML research and industrial-scale robotic execution?

If your answers are yes, we should talk.


At Nomagic, we are executing a humble pivot for general-purpose physical AI. We believe that physical AI is fundamentally a knowledge transfer problem - we are leveraging the "internet data" of robotics - massive deployment logs from real systems operating in production environments -  to bootstrap our efforts. We are looking for Research Engineers who will help us to build, train, and deploy foundational models that bring our fleet from a classical control stack to generalized AI mastery.


Offer essentials
  • Play with real robots, solving real problems, every day.
  • Relocation package.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • English-speaking environment.

    • Here is why we love this job ourselves, and hope you will enjoy it too:
  • We combine world-class research with top-notch engineering and apply it to solve real problems
  • The data already exists. We have robots in production at scale. We aren't waiting for datasets to be collected; the byproduct of our machines doing useful work is being created right now.
  • We measure what matters. We test our code in unit tests, simulations, and directly on real robots. Grounding our models in deployment allows us to truly measure performance.
  • High leverage, high impact. We’re still a highly focused team. If your training recipes improve our agents, you directly change the economics of the company.
  • World-class peers. Our team has built Google Warsaw, unicorn startups, led research in DeepMind, tested rocket engines, and worked at top companies like Nvidia and ByteDance. Now, we are shaping the reality of Physical AI together.
  • We are building the bridge. We aren't a new startup looking for an application; we are an established player bootstrapping physical AI. We believe that this will be the first true proof-of-concept for scaled physical AI.

    • What you will do
  • Your focus will be defined by the intersection of Robotics and ML and large-scale multimodal model training - expertise in both is optimal and alternatively eagerness to learn.
  • Expect challenges across two main pillars with the opportunity to specialise:
  • Core Research & Large-Scale Infrastructure
  • Own the Training Stack: Design, implement, and maintain the core infrastructure for large-scale VLA model training, including scheduling, distribution, job management, checkpointing, and rigorous logging.
  • Enable Rapid Iteration: Build the critical tools and abstractions necessary for launching, monitoring, debugging, and seamlessly reproducing complex, multi-variant experiments.
  • Train from Deployment Logs: Utilize our massive repository of offline, classical stack data to pre-train robust robot foundation models.
  • Drive the Software Feedback Loop: Translate core research needs into concrete infra capabilities, track experiments, analyze results, and close the loop directly with ML researchers to unblock model progress
  • Real-World Evaluation & Operations
  • Design Physical Benchmarks: Design new robotic tasks and build lightweight physical setups to systematically evaluate model capabilities far beyond the limits of simulation.
  • Execute Structured Evaluations: Ensure robots are properly configured, calibrated, and ready for rollouts. You will coordinate data collection efforts and run structured, on-robot evaluations to measure real-world success rates.
  • Close the Physical Feedback Loop: Analyze real-world evaluation results to guide the ML research direction. You will identify operational bottlenecks across software, hardware, and deployment systems to continuously improve our iteration speed.
  • Scale the Workflows: Beta test internal and third-party tools for teaching robots new skills, and write clear, structured documentation so the broader team can reproduce your workflows and scale your impact.

    • What skills we’d like you to have:

  • Experience: Deep experience and understanding at the intersection of machine learning, systems engineering, and robotics.

  • Proven Track Record: Experience training, fine-tuning, and deploying modern deep learning architectures (Transformers, VLMs or VLAs, Imitation Learning, RL) for robot control, ideally with policies validated on real hardware.

  • Engineering Excellence: Strong software engineering and infrastructure skills. You are highly proficient in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/JAX) and can write clean, scalable code for training and evaluation.

  • Robotics Intuition: Comfort working hands-on with hardware. You understand the robotics full stack (perception, controls, state estimation) and how to debug failures when software meets the physical world.

  • Pragmatic Research Mindset: You possess the ability to move seamlessly between research and implementation. You prefer execution, iteration speed, and real-world robustness over theoretical purity.

    • What should you expect once you apply?  

    • A phone screen with the hiring manager to discuss your background and our technical direction.
    • A half-day of on-sites (cultural fit & deep-dive technical interviews).
    • A final decision made within 2-3 days after the on-site interview.
    • Important: Expect detailed, honest feedback after completing the process, regardless of our decision.
