title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
description:
Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results?

HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working.

You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year.

About the role

As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact

Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making.

What you will do

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and. act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights;

  • Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs.

  • Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases.

  • Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances.

  • Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances.

  • Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact.

  • Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes.

  • Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments.

  • Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives. 

  • Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L. 

  • Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting.

  • Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure.

  • Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation.

  • Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled.

  • Establish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners.

  • Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board.

  • Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency.

You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers.

This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions. 

You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation. 

You will also have:

  • A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage.

  • Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role.

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations.

  • A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury.

  • Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured.

  • Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses.

  • Experience working with consolidation tools.

  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment.

  • Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage.

  • Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

  • Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year.

Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What do we offer

At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself.

You can expect:

  • a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making;

  • a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year;

  • an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role;

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.

description:
Met je hoofd in de ICT, je hart bij de zorg en oog voor de mogelijkheden van AI.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

  • Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

En is dit wat je zoekt?

  • Een passend salaris: Voor deze vacature geldt een range van € 4.000 - € 5.500 bruto p/m op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

  • €500,- persoonlijk budget: Gebruik het voor een sportabonnement, of investeer in je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld: Eventueel kun je zelfs nog 5 extra vakantiedagen erbij kopen (naar rato).

  • Beschikbare pensioenpremie: wij zijn aangesloten bij Allianz en bieden een premie met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

  • Ruimte voor groei: Binnen PharmaPartners bieden wij diverse Talentenprogamma’s aan, die gericht zijn op persoonlijke ontwikkeling, het inzetten van jouw talent en kracht en een programma om erachter te komen of dat jij jezelf in een leidinggevende rol ziet!

  • Een hechte, open werksfeer: Ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en een sterke teamspirit.

  • Leaseauto : Wij bieden jou een leaseregeling aan zodat jij met goed vervoer jouw klanten kunt bezoeken.

  • Uitdagende functie: Ga de uitdaging aan bij een organisatie die impact maakt in de samenleving in de zorgsector. Je draagt direct bij aan de maatschappij door te werken voor de zorg, waar jouw inzet het verschil maakt.

  • Sporten onder werktijd: Bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag en donderdag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s aan het eind van de dag te gaan sporten.

  • Hybride werken: Hybride werken bij ons betekent dat je twee keer per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een balans van interactie en flexibiliteit.

title: Founder's Associate Intern
description:
Als Founders Associate Intern arbeitest du direkt an der Seite des Founding Teams und bist in die wichtigsten strategischen und operativen Themen eingebunden. Die Energiewende braucht Kapital. Gleichzeitig wächst in Deutschland der Markt für Erneuerbare-Energie-Projekte – doch die passende Finanzierung kommt noch viel zu selten effizient zustande. Was bislang fehlt, ist ein Tech-Layer, der Investoren, Projektentwickler und Banken intelligent miteinander verbindet.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erste Praktika in Start-ups, Beratung oder Venture Capital.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Probleme und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand die Lösung vorgibt.

  • du fühlst dich wohler mit klaren Vorgaben, statt eigene Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • dich Rückschläge schnell aus der Bahn werfen. In einem frühen Unternehmen läuft vieles nicht beim ersten Mal, und Probleme landen oft ungefiltert auf dem Tisch.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.

You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs).

The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy.

You will join a team, based in Manchester, that is innovative and engineering-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Market Access & Prequalification: Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) into German ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and Redispatch 3.0. Support prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO and ensure our telemetry and control approach satisfies TSO-specific and BNetzA requirements for market participation. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; your focus is enabling market access, telemetry, and dispatch.)

  • Integration Technology (your core deliverable): Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit.

  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.

  • Hardware & On-site Support (occasional): Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to Kraken’s Berlin office and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English, essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration).

  • Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).

  • Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.

  • German market knowledge:

    • TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.

    • Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements.

    • Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework.

  • Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.

  • Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus, or similar IEC protocols.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus).

  • Familiarity with CLI tools for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux-based environments.

  • Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling.

  • Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany.

title: QA Engineer - Payments
description:
SumUp is already live in 38 markets and still growing. Our Global Expansion Team takes SumUp's payment products into new countries, with Mexico and Canada among our most recent launches and more markets like New Zealand and Argentina on the way. As a QA Engineer in our Berlin payments team, you'll build the automated and manual tests that decide when a new card reader can go live in a market, across frontend, backend and mobile flows, and you'll also help complete L3 certification (the final round of testing that acquiring banks and card networks require). It's hands-on engineering work with real launch impact, because your tests help new markets go live and recently launched ones stay stable, so small businesses there can take card payments with confidence.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain frontend and backend test automation, with mobile where relevant, and add targeted regression tests to continuous integration (CI) workflows so market specific checks run consistently after code changes
  • Test SumUp products across markets, with a mix of automated and manual testing, functional, integration and regression checks, plus edge cases and recovery scenarios.
  • Spot ways to improve how we test, explain why they matter and make a convincing case for the changes with the biggest payoff
  • Trace failures through complex payment flows using logs and transaction traces, then raise clear, prioritised defects and work with engineers and external partners until they're fixed
  • Own the testing of end-to-end communication between a payment terminal, software applications, and an acquiring network. with acquiring banks and card networks, and keep the team informed on certification status, quality risks and release readiness so launch decisions rest on evidence
  • Work closely in collaboration with engineers, product and market-launch teams, as well as acquirers, card schemes and certification labs.

What you'll bring

  • Programming or scripting skill to build and maintain automated tests for frontend web and backend APIs, and comfort reading code in languages such as Golang, Kotlin, Java or others on our Tech Radar.
  • Experience testing software both manually and with automation, including turning requirements into test scenarios and deciding what to automate first based on customer, launch and technical risk.
  • Ability to analyse logs, transaction traces and test results, and to write defect reports that include reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, impact and evidence.
  • Comfort working with Git and Jira (or similar tools)
  • Experience with SQL and test-data setup, contract testing, mocking or service virtualisation.
  • An engineering mindset: the ability to spot what can be improved, explain the reasoning and persuade others with clear evidence
  • A curious, ownership minded approach: seeking out context when things are unclear and using AI tools where they help.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Card payments, payment terminals, acquirers, card schemes or certification labs.
  • Market launches, device integrations, external technical partners or business-to-business communication.

Payments experience is helpful but not required. We'll support you in learning card payments, devices and the certification process.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first set up
  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
  • 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
  • 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
  • 🏖️ Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  • 🚵🏾‍♂️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
  • 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
  • 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

title: Senior Sales Engineer, DACH
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role is fully remote in Germany. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

In this role, you will: 

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.
  • Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.
  • Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.
  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in German and English.
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. STYLEX steht mit über 1.000 Artikeln für Schule, Büro und Basteln bei Drogerien und im Lebensmittelhandel im Regal und kommt auf 52 % gestützte Markenbekanntheit. Online wird daraus bisher kaum etwas: Der Anteil am Umsatz liegt bei rund 3 %, und auf Amazon verkaufen wir bislang nicht selbst.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Wir bauen ein eigenes Amazon-Seller-Geschäft auf, und du verantwortest es vom ersten Tag an: vom ersten Listing über die Margenkalkulation bis zur FBA-Anlieferung. Du suchst die Nischen, in denen unser Sortiment gewinnen kann, holst mit dem Einkauf neue Produkte dazu und entscheidest mit, was gelistet wird und was nicht.

Was du dafür nicht erst aufbauen musst: eine Marke, ein Sortiment, Lieferanten und eine Logistik. Das alles steht seit 60 Jahren. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Sales Director, die Wege zur Geschäftsführung sind kurz, und wenn der Kanal wächst, wächst die Rolle mit – bis zur Leitung des Amazon-Bereichs mit eigenem Team.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

STYLEX ist über den stationären Handel groß geworden: Drogerie, Lebensmittelhandel, Sonderposten, Baumärkte. Der Online-Handel ist mitgelaufen, aber nie aktiv aufgebaut worden. Amazon-Know-how gibt es im Haus bislang kaum.

Genau deshalb schaffen wir diese Stelle neu. Es gibt keine Vorgängerin, keine fertigen Prozesse und kein Handbuch. Es gibt ein Sortiment, das im Handel funktioniert, eine Führung, die den Kanal will, und die Aufgabe, daraus ein profitables Amazon-Geschäft zu machen.

Was du bewegen wirst

Nicht as Aufgabenliste, sondern als das, was in zwölf Monaten anders sein soll:

  • Der Seller-Account läuft. Seller Central ist sauber aufgesetzt, FBA und FBM laufen, der Account-Zustand ist gesund – und Cases mit dem Seller Support löst du, bevor sie Umsatz kosten.

  • Die Listings verkaufen. Unsere Produkte sind vollständig gelistet, werden gefunden und holen die Buy Box. Du weißt für jeden Artikel, warum er rankt oder warum nicht.

  • Jedes Produkt hat eine Marge. Einkaufspreis, Amazon-Gebühren und Marge sind pro Artikel kalkuliert. Gelistet wird, was sich rechnet.

  • Neue Produkte kommen aus deiner Recherche. Du hast Nischen nach festen Kriterien bewertet, mit dem Einkauf Lieferanten angefragt und die ersten neuen Artikel auf Amazon an den Start gebracht.

  • Der Bestand reißt nicht ab. Nachbestellungen und FBA-Sendungen sind so geplant, dass zum Schulanfang nichts ausverkauft ist.

  • Die Zahlen steuern. Umsatz, Marge und Ranking wertest du regelmäßig aus und machst daraus Maßnahmen, keine Reports.

title: Rust Product Engineer – MLS (m/f/d)
description:
Do you want to bring modern end-to-end encryption to people who rely on it every day? Then we're looking for you as a Rust Product Engineer - MLS (m/f/d) on our MLS team!

We're bringing Messaging Layer Security (MLS, RFC 9420) to secure messaging for the German public sector. MLS defines the cryptographic core of group messaging and leaves delivery, ordering, identity and federation to whoever integrates it. That's the part we build: a Rust SDK, the server that orders and delivers MLS messages, and its integration with Matrix. Much of it has no off-the-shelf answer yet.

We're also following the IETF's MIMI effort, which aims to let different messengers interoperate over MLS, and expect it to shape how our system federates.

How we work:

  • Small team, close collaboration. At Famedly the MLS team will be four to five engineers. We build the system together with a larger group of engineers at partner companies.
  • Ownership in small groups. Day to day you work with two or three others on a project or a part of the system, and you own it from spec to operations.
  • AI where it helps, people where it counts. We use coding agents a lot, for implementation, tests and exploring options. Protocol design, security-relevant decisions and the final review stay with people, and we keep adjusting where that line runs.
  • Think first, then build. Architecture decision records, specs and written invariants keep both humans and agents on track, and we check our code against them.


Your responsibilities:

  • Turn requirements from our customer, the MLS standard and Matrix into specs and architecture decisions.
  • Decide with your team and our partners where a change belongs: the SDK, the server, or a spec proposal.
  • Build and run server-side MLS components in Rust, including message delivery, the Matrix integration and federation between servers.
  • Ship your work to production yourself, including in our customer's environments.
  • Contribute to spec proposals where they affect what we build.
  • Improve our agent workflows and share what you learn.


What you should bring:

  • At least three years of experience with Rust in production, including async Rust (Tokio or similar).
  • You already work with coding agents every day and have your own workflows for them.
  • Sharp judgment in code review: you notice when generated code looks plausible but is wrong, for example a race in message ordering or an error path that silently loses state.
  • Experience with distributed systems or network protocols: ordering, consistency, failure modes.
  • You can read an RFC and turn it into code and tests.
  • You enjoy writing: specs, decision records, review comments.
  • Fluent German and English.


Nice to have: MLS, MIMI, Matrix, applied cryptography, experience in regulated markets (public sector, healthcare, critical infrastructure), or rigorous testing approaches such as property-based testing.

Please note: For this position, we are currently only able to consider applications from candidates based in EU/EEA.

Why you should work at Famedly:

  • Work at a fast-growing startup in an exciting phase. Since 2019 we have grown rapidly and we have big plans ahead! Famedly brought the first gematik-certified TI-Messenger to market, and with your help we're now bringing MLS-secured messaging to the public sector.
  • Meaningful ownership. Take responsibility for software people rely on every day in critical environments.
  • Deep technical work. Help build one of the first MLS deployments in the German public sector, on a protocol whose ecosystem is still taking shape.
  • Small, close-knit teams. Work in a small team with short decision paths.
  • Modern AI tooling. Use up-to-date coding agents and models without having to count tokens.
  • Your perfect work-life balance. With remote work and flexible hours, you decide when and where you are most productive. You also have the option to work from our office in Berlin. Your choice: set up your home office or use a co-working space!
  • Attractive conditions. A permanent contract with competitive compensation, a training budget, work equipment of your choice, and 28 vacation days per year.
  • Flexible Benefits with Probonio. You receive a monthly wellbeing budget that you can use for vouchers from a wide range of food, mobility, retail, and lifestyle partners or for a discounted membership with Urban Sports Club.
  • A diverse and international team. We value an open mindset and a diverse, inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome.
  • Regular team events. Workshops, team-building activities, virtual game nights, and company events such as our Summer and Winter Summit.


We are a proud equal-opportunities employer and place great value on mutual tolerance and acceptance in a diverse environment. Everyone receives the same opportunities in our application process. We look forward to hearing from you!

description:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer sind wir

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Was für dich drin ist

  • Du führst die gesamte Recruiting-Abteilung und machst sie zum Wachstumsmotor des Unternehmens
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein Datenpartner an deiner Seite: Unser Sales & HR Analyst liefert die Zahlen, du entscheidest, was daraus folgt
  • Direkter Impact: Jeder starke Hire in Sales und Account Management bewegt unseren Umsatz sichtbar
  • Verdienst ab 75.000 € p. a. plus leistungsbasiertem Bonus
  • Remote möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office in Hockenheim
  • Investition in dein Skill-Development und 4 Team Events pro Jahr

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung. Du führst das bestehende Team und baust Prozesse, Standards und SOPs auf. Für unsere Key-Hires in Sales und Account Management trägst du die volle Verantwortung, vom Erstkontakt bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Die besten Kandidaten suchen meist gar nicht, deshalb gehst du über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache selbst auf sie zu.

Du steuerst den gesamten Funnel: Kennenlerngespräch, Bewerbungsgespräch, Probetag, Referenzcheck und Angebot. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur, also Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs, Landingpages und Recruiting-Ads. Du legst fest, was im Recruiting gemessen wird, und setzt das Dashboard in Close und Recruitee so auf, dass es echte Entscheidungen ermöglicht. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst wertest du die Zahlen aus, erkennst Engpässe und passt Prozesse an.

Deine Recruiter führst und coachst du, und mit Call-Reviews sicherst du die Qualität ihrer Arbeit. Neue Hires übergibst du sauber an die Teamleads und ins Onboarding. Was die Probezeit zeigt, fließt bei dir zurück in den Auswahlprozess. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht an Aktivität, sondern an Ergebnissen:

  • Time-to-Hire pro Rolle
  • Conversion zwischen den Funnel-Stufen
  • Anzahl qualifizierter Kandidaten bis zur Besetzung
  • Offer-Acceptance-Rate
  • Pipeline-Abdeckung für unsere Key-Rollen
  • Wer von deinen Hires die Probezeit besteht und nach 90 Tagen performt
  • Performance deines Teams

Das bringst du mit

  • Eigener Sales-Background: Du warst selbst im Closing, im Setting oder als Sales Lead aktiv. Du weißt, wie Vertriebler ticken, weil du einer bist
  • Nachweislich besetzte Sales- und Account-Management-Rollen im B2B-High-Ticket-Umfeld, etwa in Agentur, Beratung, Coaching oder Online-Business
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-System mit Funnel, Prozessen, Scorecards und Tracking aufgebaut und nicht nur darin gearbeitet

  • Ownership: Wenn zwei Wochen lang kein Bewerbungsgespräch zustande kommt, merkst du es selbst, findest die Ursache und handelst, bevor jemand fragt

title: Customer Success Manager (w/m/d) - Werkstudium oder Pflichtpraktikum
description:
Ein Abschluss ist bei uns kein Ziel, sondern ein Startpunkt.

Ab da sorgst du dafür, dass aus einem Vertrag ein zufriedener Kunde wird.

Bloom Future bringt Jugendliche zwischen 15 und 20 über Selbstreflexion zu passenden Ausbildungswegen und verbindet sie mit Ausbildungsbetrieben aus der Region. Die Unternehmen kaufen dabei keine Plattform, sie wollen passende Bewerbungen für ihre Ausbildungsplätze. Ob wir das liefern, entscheidet sich nicht im Verkaufsgespräch, sondern in den zwölf Monaten danach.

Warum diese Rolle das Bindeglied ist

Unser Vertrieb gewinnt die Unternehmen, unser Marketing sorgt dafür, dass ihre Stellen bei den richtigen Jugendlichen ankommen. Du sitzt genau dazwischen. Du kennst die Ziele unserer Kunden, siehst in den Zahlen, ob unsere Maßnahmen wirken, und sorgst dafür, dass Vertrieb, Marketing und Kunde immer auf demselben Stand sind.

Aufgaben

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach dem Abschluss und begleitest sie durch das Onboarding. Gemeinsam mit den Unternehmen bringst du ihre Stellenanzeigen auf der Plattform so in Form, dass sie bei Jugendlichen wirklich ankommen.

Danach wird es analytisch. Du wertest aus, wie die Kampagnen und Maßnahmen für unsere Kunden laufen: Wie oft werden die Stellen gesehen, wie viele Klicks und Bewerbungen kommen rein, wo hakt es? Liegt ein Kunde hinter seinen Zielen, erkennst du das früh und stimmst mit dem Marketing ab, welche Maßnahme jetzt greift, etwa eine regionale Anzeigenkampagne oder eine überarbeitete Stellenanzeige.

Aus diesen Zahlen machst du Kommunikation. Du erstellst regelmäßige Reports für unsere Kunden, schreibst Newsletter und hältst den Kontakt so, dass Unternehmen jederzeit wissen, was mit ihren Stellen passiert und was wir als Nächstes tun.

Dabei denkst du das Schuljahr mit. Jugendliche suchen nicht das ganze Jahr gleich, rund um Praktikumsphasen, Halbjahresinformation oder Zeugnisse verändert sich die Nachfrage. Diesen Rhythmus nutzt du, um die richtigen Maßnahmen zur richtigen Zeit anzustoßen.

Und du bist der Kanal zurück ins Team. Du behältst die Vertragslaufzeiten im Blick, damit Kunden zur Verlängerung zufrieden sind und nicht erst dann gefragt werden. Will ein Unternehmen mehr Stellen besetzen, gibt du das an den Vertrieb weiter. Fehlt Kunden etwas im Produkt, landet das bei unserem Produktteam. Weil wir Customer Success gerade so aufbauen, dass er auch mit Hunderten Kunden funktioniert, gestaltest du Abläufe, Vorlagen und Automatisierungen aktiv mit.

Kein reiner Support, der Anfragen abarbeitet. Du verstehst, misst und kommunizierst, in dieser Reihenfolge.

Qualifikation

Wen wir uns vorstellen

Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben und hast rund 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit. Ob du BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation, Psychologie oder etwas ganz anderes studierst, ist zweitrangig. Erste Erfahrung in Kundenbetreuung, Marketing oder Projektarbeit ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Wichtiger ist uns: Du hast keine Scheu vor Zahlen und arbeitest gern mit Google Sheets oder Excel. Du kannst aus einer Auswertung eine klare Aussage machen und sie so aufschreiben, dass Personalverantwortliche im Mittelstand sie in zwei Minuten verstehen. Du bist gern im Austausch mit Menschen, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei vielen Kunden gleichzeitig den Überblick.

Fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englisch von Vorteil.

Benefits

Was du bekommst

Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach deinem Stundenplan richten, und hybrides Arbeiten zwischen Office und Homeoffice.

Firmenlaptop und modernes CRM.

Arbeitsplatz am Campus Founders in Heilbronn, direkt auf dem Bildungscampus. Mensa, kostenloser Kaffee, Softdrinks, regelmäßige Teamevents und Veranstaltungen der Campus Community.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

Customer Success entsteht bei uns gerade. Es gibt einen klaren Rahmen mit definierten Abläufen und Maßnahmen, aber vieles davon gestaltest du mit. Du arbeitest eng mit den Gründern zusammen und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt: bei zufriedenen Unternehmen und bei Jugendlichen, die über Bloom Future ihren Ausbildungsplatz finden.

Schick deine Bewerbung direkt an Carlo Mailänder. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Kurzer Lebenslauf, ein paar Sätze, warum die Rolle zu dir passt, fertig.

Vergütung

Für diese Werkstudententätigkeit gilt ein Stundenlohn von EUR 15–17.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.

Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.

We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.

What You'll Do

  • Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
  • Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
  • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.

title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
description:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, or atmospheric sciences.

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.
