We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem.   • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

title: Senior Nuclear Theorist - Few-Body Physics (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

Snap Fusion develops a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy.

We are a small team of physicists and engineers. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high. Our findings feed into research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for Physics and quantum technologies.

Some problems are too important not to solve.

Your mission
Lead the nuclear theory behind a new approach to fusion energy.

At Snap Fusion, we are pursuing a bold mission: developing a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy.

Parts of our roadmap rest on questions of low-energy nuclear physics. Some of these have clear answers in the literature; others turn out, on close reading, to be less settled than they first appear. Knowing which is which matters to us, because it shapes what we build and what we test.

We are therefore establishing an in-house nuclear theory effort, and we are looking for a senior few-body theorist to lead it. Your job will be to decide which of our questions current theory can actually answer, to answer those at a standard that would hold up to expert review, and to say plainly where the uncertainties lie.

This is an unusual setting for a theorist, in a good way: the questions are concrete, the team is small, and your conclusions will be acted on.

What you will do

You will work directly with the founders as theory lead. Your responsibilities may include:

• Leading theory projects from problem definition to a clear recommendation

• Judging which questions current nuclear theory can answer, and with what uncertainty

• Carrying out and supervising few-body scattering and reaction calculations

• Setting the benchmarks and cross-checks against which results are accepted

• Working with our computational physics lead on the numerical implementation of the methods you specify

• Reviewing theoretical and experimental claims that bear on our roadmap

• Building collaborations with academic groups, including for independent confirmation of key results

• Helping the rest of the team understand the physics behind your conclusions

Your assessments will directly inform Snap Fusion's technology roadmap.

What we’re looking for

You will probably hold a PhD in theoretical nuclear physics or a closely related field, with research experience beyond it. Ideal candidates will have strong experience in several of the following areas:

Nuclear theory

• Quantum scattering and reaction theory

• Few-body or ab initio methods

• Realistic nuclear interactions

• Resonances, thresholds, and continuum physics

• Low-energy charged-particle reactions

• Fusion cross sections and astrophysical S-factors

Scientific leadership. You should be comfortable:

• Running a research program with milestones and honest go/no-go decisions

• Saying that a question cannot be answered with current theory, when it cannot

• Writing clearly for readers who are not few-body specialists

• Reviewing other people's derivations, and having your own reviewed

Like most few-body theorists, you will have done a good deal of numerical work, and that experience will be valuable here. But this is a physics role first: we have a computational physics lead, and implementation is a collaboration rather than the core of your job.

Industry experience is not required.

Bonus Points

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

• Light-nuclei reaction calculations

• R-matrix or related continuum methods

• Nuclear astrophysics

• Benchmark comparisons between methods or codes

• Close collaboration with experimentalists

• Refereeing and reviewing

• Teaching or mentoring

Who thrives here?

You may be a great fit if:

• You like physics questions with practical consequences

• You would rather establish a modest result firmly than a striking one loosely

• You are comfortable saying “we don't know yet” and explaining why

• You enjoy making difficult material clear to colleagues from other fields

• You want to see your work used

This role suits someone who wants to keep doing serious theory while seeing it put to use.

Why join Snap Fusion?

The questions you settle will feed into research in:

• Fusion energy

• Scientific discovery

• Advanced simulation

• AI for Physics

• Quantum technologies

You will work alongside physicists and engineers on problems where careful theory has direct consequences. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high.

description:

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. For more information, visit WPP.com.

Als Senior Project Manager Digital (m/w/d) in Hamburg oder Berlin übernimmst du die eigenverantwortliche Steuerung von Kundenprojekten – von komplexen Digital-Kampagnen bis hin zu Omnichannel-Produktionen. Du hast Zeit, Budget und Qualitätsstandards fest im Blick, planst Ressourcen vorausschauend und steuerst die Abläufe souverän.   • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Produktionseinheiten sowie Nearshore- und Offshore-Teams

Das bringst du mit

  • Umfassende Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement digitaler Projekte, idealerweise ergänzt durch Print- und Bewegtbild-Expertise
  • Weitreichendes technisches Verständnis für Produktionsprozesse im Digitalbereich (Web-Technologien, Social Media Formate, Standard-Werbemittel)
  • Umfassendes Zahlenverständnis für Kalkulationssicherheit und Budgetkontrolle

  • Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Offenheit für den Einsatz von KI-gestützten Technologien

Bei uns findest du nicht nur spannende Aufgaben, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, das deine Entwicklung, Flexibilität und dein Wohlbefinden in den Mittelpunkt stellt. Entdecke unsere vielfältigen Vorteile:

Arbeitskultur & Perspektiven:

  • Spannende, vielseitige Projekte in einem schnell wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
  • Offene Vertrauenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung
  • Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche zur Talentförderung und Karriereentwicklung
  • Umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten über unser globales WPP Netzwerk (Trainings, Webinare, E-Learning)

Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance:

  • Hybrid Working und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Cross-Border Working (europaweit) – Arbeite flexibel auch jenseits der Landesgrenzen
  • Ein zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaubstag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Tätigkeiten bei einer eingetragenen Wohltätigkeitsorganisation
  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für eine produktive Umgebung
  • 28 reguläre Urlaubstage pro Jahr, plus einem zusätzlichen freien Tag an deinem Geburtstag

Gesundheit & Extras:

  • Umfassende Gesundheits- und Wellness-Angebote (z.B. psychologische Beratung, Fitness, Prävention)
  • Attraktives Corporate-Benefit-Programm mit Rabatten bei zahlreichen Marken
  • Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge (inkl. vermögenswirksamer Leistungen / VWL)
  • Beteiligung am Deutschland Ticket
  • Möglichkeit zur Nutzung eines Job Bikes

Du würdest deine Fähigkeiten gerne in einer internationalen Agentur weiter ausbauen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und schnellstmöglichen Verfügbarkeit!

At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

title: People Operations Working Student (m/f/d)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a People Operations Working Student for a 6-month contract to our People Operations team in Berlin, Germany!

This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics(e.g. employment law and payroll). You will also gain valuable exposure to driving efficient operations at scale. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply analytical problem-solving, a process-oriented mindset, stakeholder management and AI automation to elevate our HR systems (e.g., Personio) and workflows… all within a dynamic, international environment. Whilst you will be based in Germany, you will be working on operations across European markets.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Employee Care: Respond thoughtfully to employee queries, ensuring quick, effective resolutions and an exceptional day-to-day experience for our team.
  • Process Mindset & Execution: Ensure high accuracy and operational efficiency in core HR processes (e.g. maintaining Personio data, payroll) by following clear procedures.
  • Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Challenge the status quo by focusing on solutions rather than getting bogged down in problems. Use data and a process mindset to proactively identify ways to optimize workflows and leverage automation to better serve our employees at scale.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are currently enrolled in a university, your specific degree subject matter does not matter but an interest in HR, Finance and operations is a plus
  • You are available at least 15h/week (max. 20 hours)
  • A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.
  • A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.
  • A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity.
  • A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in data-driven problem solving, project management, stakeholder management, and operations across Europe.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that current university enrollment and fluency in German and English (C1+) are mandatory requirements.

 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. 

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

 

At Wolt, as a part of Doordash, we're building the industry's most scalable and reliable delivery platform to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and courier partners. 

What makes our team unique:

  • Our global Security team aspires to be the world's most admired security team, with members across EU, UK and North America (operating as Wolt, Deliveroo and Doordash).
  • We're shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our "classic" platforms of the three companies.

title: Founding engineer, AI on CAD geometry (co-founder equity)
description:
Founding engineer: AI that reads mechanical designs (Berlin / remote EU):

LoopforgeLab enables machine and hardware makers make better design decisions by better we mean shorter design iterations, more sustainable products with less cost to manfuacture and own.

We are building the Forge Engine is an agentic tool for manufacturing. Give it a BOM and a STEP file and it returns what the part costs to make and what the machine will cost to own over fifteen years, while there is still time to change the design. The lifecycle engine is built and runs on declared drivers. The agent already modifies geometry from natural-language instructions on our platform.

The next piece is the reason we are hiring. We need geometry reasoning that holds up on real customer CAD: feature recognition from B-rep, tolerances read per feature rather than per part, similarity against parts we have already costed, and an evaluation setup that shows whether the agent is improving or only sounding more certain. Also we need to build integrations with different CAD/ER and PLM systems.

What you would own:

  • The geometry reasoning module. Feature extraction from STEP, manufacturability signals, tolerance and surface finish handling.

  • The design agent’s optimisation loop. Iterating a design against a cost or lifecycle target rather than following instructions.

  • Evaluation. Benchmarks, regression suites, and the discipline to drop approaches that do not beat the baseline.

  • Architecture decisions with the founder, including when LLM reasoning beats rules and when it does not.

  • Reasoning Engine and live context retriever

Who you probably are:

  • Strong experience with one of those: Python/Rust and C++ and real ML depth. You have built at least once in your life a geometric deep learning, GNNs, 3D representation learning modules in real production data settings and they're used by real users right now.

  • You have touched mechanical engineering for real. A degree, CAE/CAD/CAM work, manufacturing process knowledge, or a PhD near feature recognition, DFM or process simulation. You know why a tight tolerance on one face costs more than a loose one on five.

  • Comfortable with messy industrial data. Re-exported CAD that parses differently, BOMs with missing fields, 40 parts rather than 40,000.

  • You ship. Two-week demoable checkpoints rather than six-month research tracks.

  • Familiar with sustainability concepts and how do they be applied in the context of design and manufacturing

Nice to have:

  • OpenCascade, PythonOCC, or commercial CAD kernel experience.

Co-founder-level equity with standard vesting. You would be the thrid engineer in the room, which means you own things outright, including the parts nobody enjoys. We plan to open source what the community builds and put a private product layer on top.

title: Staff Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.

Job Overview

Our Structure team builds the software foundation for consistent, scalable index development at Solactive. We provide APIs, libraries, configuration patterns, testing frameworks, and reusable components for index construction workflows, supporting a great UX for ideation, production, and maintenance of new indices with clients. In this senior role, you will shape the technical architecture of a business-critical service that accelerates index development and improves quality across the index lifecycle. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Tasks

  • Lead the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions for internal and external users of the index development service.
  • Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure.
  • Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability.
  • Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision.
  • Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.
  • Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk.
  • Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery.

Your Profile

  • Strong hands-on software engineering background (10+ years) with deep expertise in common programming languages. We use Java, Python, and Typescript.
  • Strong system design skills, including service decomposition, API design, integration patterns, data modeling, scalability, reliability, and operational concerns in cloud-native environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deploying, operating, and troubleshooting cloud-native applications in containerized environments.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into quality technical solutions.
  • Proven track record of simplifying complex systems and delivering maintainable end-to-end solutions with high business impact.
  • Strong experience with modern engineering practices: code reviews, design reviews, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, incident response, and production ownership.

This is a brand new role, created to own what happens once a customer has found the right journey and moves towards booking: reservation details, optional extras and payment. Because it sits so close to the point of purchase, it offers a direct line to customer experience and revenue, and plenty of room to grow. You will work alongside our Search team and the Supply and Payments platform teams, with colleagues in commercial, design, data and engineering, to make booking simple and reliable for customers in every market we serve.

  • Own the customer experience from the moment someone chooses a journey to a confirmed booking, setting clear goals for conversion (the share of customers who complete their booking) and revenue while enabling other teams with a stake in the journey.

Decide when a market or carrier specific improvement is the right investment, and when to bring ideas and learnings together across markets so that value grows for customers everywhere, rather than staying in one place.

  • Balance wider business goals from other teams, such as adding new supply, increasing booking features for each carrier, and introducing optional extras and new revenue streams, against keeping the journey simple and low in friction for customers.

  • Bring AI tools into your everyday work, such as prototyping, analysis and delivery, and help the team grow in confidence using them.

  • Clear, thoughtful communication, with the ability to explain complex trade-offs and build alignment between teams who may have different priorities.

The role

Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that.

The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A.

What you'll do

Financial reporting and month-end close

  • Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable

  • Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements

  • Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions

Compliance and risk oversight

  • Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers

  • Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards

  • Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status

  • Be the accountable owner if something in the compliance chain breaks down

Commercial business partnering

  • Be the day-to-day finance partner to UK&Europe leadership, owning the regional P&L narrative, budget vs actual and the "why" behind the numbers

  • Bring a commercial lens to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, flagging risk and opportunity early

  • Translate regional performance into clear, decision-ready input for FP&A and company leadership

  • Give UK&Europe business leaders a reliable, self-serve view of their numbers, so decisions stop waiting on Australian hours

  • Feed central finance the regional inputs it needs at close: accrual estimates, revenue and spend context, then review and sign off on the UK&Europe result

Revenue risk and collections

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to resolve aged and disputed balances and unblock stuck revenue

  • Own the commercial view of collection risk: which accounts, why, and what it means for cash, and feed it into forecasting

  • Drive down UK&Europe DSO by fixing the upstream causes (contracting, disputes, process), not by chasing invoices

FinOps, controls and performance frameworks

  • Build the operating rhythm that turns UK&Europe finance from reactive support into a reliable performance framework: clear KPIs, owners, review cadences and escalation paths

  • Partner with budget owners on spend decisions before they are made, rather than policing them after the fact

  • Strengthen financial controls across spend, approvals, vendor onboarding, card usage, subscriptions and commercial commitments, while keeping the process pragmatic for a fast-moving region

  • Review regional AP and card activity, including prompt removal of leaver access and cards, and escalate anomalies to central finance operations

  • Partner with external accountants, tax advisers, compliance providers and other vendors, making sure work is well-scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi’s internal finance standards

  • Use FinOps-style discipline to connect spend, usage and outcomes, especially across tooling, GTM systems, implementation costs and region-specific operating expenses

  • Create simple documentation and control checks so the region can scale without relying on informal knowledge or one-off fixes

What you'll need

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen — comfortable moving between P&L narrative, deal economics and cash impact

  • Experience business partnering with Sales, Customer Success or regional leadership in a growth business

  • Track record improving collections or DSO by fixing root causes, not just process

  • Experience owning spend or expense controls in a way that supports the business rather than only governing it

  • Comfortable directing (not necessarily performing) statutory compliance and VAT work through external advisers

  • High degree of autonomy and ownership in a small, remote-first global finance team

  • Clear, confident communicator — able to hold your own with commercial leaders and external advisers alike

  • Experience in a multi-entity or multi-currency business

Nice to have

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company

  • Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent)

  • Exposure to Companies House, HMRC and Irish Revenue processes

  • Experience with Campfire, Airwallex or similar modern finance tooling

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

title: Senior Product Manager

description:
About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

Location and availability

Candidates must already be based in Paris or elsewhere in Île-de-France.

We are not considering relocation from other regions or countries for this position.

We're looking for someone who can join the team quickly.

We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. Your main mission will be to:

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots

En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH :

  • ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids ;

  • c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle.

Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies.

C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché, au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record :

  • une plateforme collaborative et ouverte, qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises ;

  • l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. ;

  • la valorisation des données de paie et sociales, pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle…

L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH.

 

🚀 Tes responsabilités

Ta mission est de concevoir et faire vivre les systèmes de fonctionnement d'Alassio. Concrètement, tu identifies partout dans l'entreprise ce qui empêche les équipes de travailler à l'échelle (un process défaillant ou absent, un passage de relais flou, une information introuvable, une tâche répétitive que personne n'a pris le temps d'automatiser) et tu le résous de bout en bout : un diagnostic précis, puis un cahier des charges documenté et actionnable, puis l'accompagnement de sa mise en œuvre jusqu'à son adoption effective par les équipes. Une solution que personne n'utilise n'est pas une solution.

Tes leviers sont aussi bien managériaux (formalisme interne, rituels, répartition des responsabilités) que produit et techniques (modèle de données, outillage, automatisation des flux de travail), avec un parti pris constant : « Just build it ». Tu mettras en place, avec les équipes concernées, des solutions actionnables et des systèmes qui tournent.

 

🧭 Tes premiers chantiers

Pour te donner une idée concrète, voici le type de chantiers que tu pourrais mener dans tes six premiers mois :

  1. Bâtir un réseau national de formateurs et d'intégrateurs certifiés, pour permettre aux cabinets de se former partout en France sans saturer nos équipes à chaque pic de déploiement : modèle économique et tarification, maillage du territoire avec les Sales, parcours de certification et suivi qualité avec l'équipe DnA (Déploiement & Accompagnement), cadre contractuel, et circuit de remontée des demandes des cabinets vers le support et le Product. En bref, tu contribueras à mettre sur pied une place de marché d'intégrateurs et de formateurs Alassio.

  2. Fluidifier le parcours d'un cabinet, de la signature à la production : formaliser les passages de relais entre les squads Sales, DnA, Métier & Juridique et Tech (ce qui est transmis, dans quel outil, dans quel délai, et qui tranche en cas de blocage). Ce travail se traduit par la mise en place de workflows au sein de Bedrock, notre OS interne : il rend l'ensemble du contexte d'Alassio interrogeable et permet de transformer quasi instantanément une solution que tu as formalisée en gain concret pour toute l'équipe.

  3. Améliorer en profondeur, en coordination étroite avec l'AI Engineer, notre OS Bedrock pour en faire le réflexe par défaut de toutes les équipes : identifier les cas d'usage transverses à plus fort impact, structurer le contexte métier qui alimente l'OS, travailler sur l'hébergement et la dimension collaborative, mettre en place des workflows d'agents déclenchés par événement, tenir à jour le catalogue des commandes, et mettre en place le suivi qui mesure la performance et l'adoption.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans des rôles opérationnels (GTM, Ops) ou en conseil en stratégie, idéalement avec une dimension technique, dans des contextes où tu as vu la structure d'une équipe évoluer vite (par exemple une scale-up, ou une refonte organisationnelle chez des clients en conseil)

  • Une compréhension fine des goulots d'étranglement organisationnels et informationnels qui ralentissent les entreprises à mesure qu'elles grandissent, et des transformations que l'IA est en train d'y opérer

  • Le goût des défis techniques et un esprit très analytique, sans perdre ton profil généraliste : tes expériences t'ont amené(e) à croiser les expertises, entre commercial et technique, produit et métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables

  • Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic

  • Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme

  3. Étude de cas à partir de situations réelles, à dominante technique, avec Hector (COO) et Paul Rousseau (Founding SWE) : 1 h30

  4. Rencontre informelle de l'équipe dans nos bureaux, puis échange séparé avec les fondateurs

  5. Deux à troise prises de référence

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

Tu rejoins une aventure entrepreneuriale en plein passage à l'échelle, sur un marché verrouillé depuis des années. Notre conviction : les bons process libèrent les équipes, les mauvais les étouffent. Ton rôle est précisément de concevoir les premiers, pour que chaque équipe d'Alassio aille plus vite, avec l'ambition assumée de bâtir une référence en matière d'organisation nativement construite autour de l'IA.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Faire le lien entre notre technologie et celles et ceux qui l’utilisent : accompagner nos clients, partenaires et collègues, principalement sur le marché français et plus largement dans les marchés francophones, pour qu’ils comprennent la plateforme Kaluza et surtout la maîtrisent.

  • Être un partenaire de confiance : mener des analyses approfondies des besoins de formation pour comprendre les défis propres à chaque client, partenaire et équipe interne.

  • Concevoir des programmes d’apprentissage sur mesure qui vont au-delà de la formation et produisent des résultats business mesurables.

  • Créer des supports de formation de grande qualité, en français et en anglais : ateliers interactifs, modules d’e-learning et guides de référence rapide.

  • Accélérer l’adoption de la plateforme Kaluza grâce à un accompagnement et à du coaching après la formation.

  • Suivre l’efficacité de vos programmes et les améliorer en continu à partir des retours et des indicateurs de performance, pour que la formation ait un impact concret pour nos utilisateurs et pour le secteur de l’énergie.


Ce que vous apportez

Critères essentiels :

  • Bilinguisme : vous êtes à l’aise en français comme en anglais, avec d’excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale.

  • Expertise en formation SaaS : vous avez une expérience avérée de conception et d’animation de programmes de formation à fort impact dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique.

  • Sens de la simplification : vous savez naturellement traduire des concepts techniques et métier complexes en supports clairs, engageants et pratiques.

  • Talent d’animation : vous êtes un·e intervenant·e dynamique et sûr·e de vous, capable de captiver des publics variés et de créer un cadre d’apprentissage interactif et convivial.

  • Esprit collaboratif et proactif : vous travaillez bien en équipe, vous construisez des relations solides et vous identifiez spontanément des façons d’aider les autres et de progresser en continu.

  • Une connaissance du secteur de l’énergie : une expérience concrète des opérations d’un fournisseur d’énergie ou des technologies de décarbonation, pour relier la formation aux défis réels de nos clients.

  • Une culture de l’excellence opérationnelle : une connaissance des processus de centre de contact ou des technologies de service client, pour concevoir des formations qui améliorent l’efficacité opérationnelle.

  • Une expérience de leadership en formation : un parcours démontré de montée en charge de programmes de formation et une capacité à réfléchir stratégiquement à la construction d’une culture d’apprentissage au sein d’une organisation internationale.

  • Résoudre le vrai problème : Dépasser la complexité pour se concentrer sur des résultats concrets.

  • Bâtir la confiance chaque jour : Cohérence, transparence et tenir parole.

  • Assumer les résultats : Une responsabilité totale, dans les réussites comme dans les revers, sans ego.

  • Aller plus loin ensemble : Collaboration, respect et diversité des points de vue.

Nous voulons rencontrer des personnes de tous horizons. Plus nous sommes inclusifs, meilleur sera notre travail, et nous reconnaissons les talents sur la base du mérite et du potentiel.   • Client Integration & Technical Governance (External Focus)

    • Technical Consulting: Serve as a primary technical contact during client integration projects, translating internal platform architecture and dependencies into clear, actionable requirements for the client's technical teams.

    • Environment Alignment: Own the technical coordination for critical implementation elements across - infrastructure, access, services, APIs, Applications, and DataMart ensuring setup/configuration of client testing and production environments.

    • Security Assurance & Data Protection: Work with clients and Kaluza SMEs to ensure the kaluza platform meets minimum security and data protection requirements. Manage the definition of needs, implementation approach, validation and auditing activities. 

    • Technical Risk Communication: Proactively communicate technical risks, constraints, and trade-offs inherent in the implementation process to client stakeholders and internal commercial teams.

  • Core Platform & Infrastructure Delivery (Internal Focus)

    • Infrastructure Roadmap: Manage internal projects focused on the enhancement and stability of our Technical Infrastructure (Cloud environments, containerization, security tooling) and Tech Operations maturity.

    • Engineering Alignment: Collaborate with Platform Architects, DevOps, and Data Engineering teams to define project scope, secure resources, and manage technical dependencies.

    • Reliability & Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and data projects adhere to security protocols, regulatory requirements, and internal reliability targets.


  • Delivery Methodologies & Reporting

    • Agile Proficiency: Apply expert knowledge of Scrum and Kanban within an engineering context, managing sprint planning, backlog refinement, and continuous delivery practices.

    • System Integration: Also apply your organisational and management skills to large scale, fixed time system integration programs in a way that promotes transparency and minimises delivery risk.

    • Reporting: Provide transparent, data-driven reporting using Jira dashboards and quantifiable metrics, clearly showing the status of both internal delivery and external client dependencies.

    • Blocker Resolution: Facilitate technical and architectural decisions, acting as the primary point of contact to resolve critical technical roadblocks for both internal and client teams.

    • Team / Relationship Management: Form strong working relationships with clients and internal teams. Effectively operate in a matrix team structure. Lead and facilitate meetings and ceremonies.

About You

  • Circa 5 years: of experience as a Technical Project/Program Manager, specifically in roles that required simultaneous management of internal platform engineering and B2B client integrations.

  • Hands-on exposure: to the technicalities of, environment provisioning, security and data projects.

  • Proven track record of navigating the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) within a high-growth SaaS, FinTech, or EnergyTech environment.

description:
Join our mission, join Doctolib! 

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join the Patient team in Paris. 

The Patient domain sits at the heart of Doctolib's mission: ensuring everyone has better access to the care they need, receives better care from health professionals, and can actively prevent health problems to improve their wellbeing.

You’ll design the search and recommendation engines behind our health companion, helping 100M patients across Europe instantly navigate to the exact care they need while delivering trusted, curated insights at every step. The retrieval and recommendation architecture you own will directly shape how relevant, fast, and trustworthy that experience is for every one of them.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and build the production search & recommendation architecture: full retrieval, ranking, reranking pipeline with standard and off-the-shelf components (vector search, semantic retrieval, LLM/managed rerankers).

  • Establish strong baselines first (prompts, RAG, model selection) before reaching for custom ML.

  • Build evaluation and observability into every stage, with offline and online evaluation.

  • Set up the data/event feedback loops that drive iteration and feed deeper ML later.

  • Improve search relevance and ranking on Patient facing products , raising result quality

  • Own production quality: latency reliability, monitoring, and maintainability.

  • Partner with ML Engineers and collaborate closely with PMs and SWEs to define, build, and ship AI-powered features that deliver measurable value to users and the business. 


Who you are

Before you read on:  if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Marketing - First Hire (m/f/d), German Speaking
description:
About The Company

At NaroIQ, we believe the fund industry is undergoing a structural shift: investors are more cost-conscious and transparency-driven than ever, and ETFs are a natural outcome of this shift.

Yet many capital management companies (ManCos) excel at running traditional mutual funds - but struggle to enter the ETF market. Launching and operating ETFs adds a new layer of complexity: new partners, interfaces, processes, and systems that most existing setups weren't built for.

NaroIQ gives ManCos a fast, reliable path into the ETF market. We provide the digital ETF infrastructure that reduces operational complexity, so ManCos can launch and run ETFs at scale and compete effectively, helping broaden access to the market beyond dominant, US-based providers.

We are remote-first, with in-person collaboration opportunities. We work with international clients and have raised over $10m from top-tier investors and operators across finance and technology.

The Role and What Makes It Special

You own the two functions that decide how the outside world experiences NaroIQ: How we are perceived in the market, and who we manage to attract to build it. Marketing and Employer Branding sit together in one role at NaroIQ because the same narrative - sharp, technical, high quality - has to land with senior executives and journalists as well as with the engineers, operators and commercial talent we want to hire next.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will not manage a team of specialists who do the work - you'll do the work: drafting the LinkedIn post, creating our brand strategy, building relationships with journalists, organizing events, designing an employer brand. And you'll build the systems that let NaroIQ scale this without losing sharpness.

There is no marketing playbook to inherit and nobody above you in the function. You set the priorities, decide what not to do, and carry the call. That takes unusual self-drive - the kind where nobody has to ask you for a status update, and where an unclear brief is something you resolve rather than escalate.

You report to the CEO (Chris) and work in tight loops with Growth, Product and the leadership team. Over time, you have the opportunity to grow the function around you.

Tasks

What You'll Do

PR & Events

  • Run PR campaigns end-to-end, directly and with external PR partners, to build durable credibility and secure consistent placements in tier-1 outlets (Handelsblatt, Bloomberg, FT) and the FinTech and asset-management publications that matter

  • Plan and coordinate events and speaking slots (e.g. Money20/20, FinTech and asset-management conferences, exclusive industry roundtables)

Content & Brand

  • Build and maintain a consistent brand identity across every surface: website, pitch deck, one-pagers, careers page, sales collateral
  • Create a brand that sticks with our audience: You decide how we are perceived in the market and what the NaroIQ storyline should look like

Demand Generation & Sales Alignment

  • Develop the materials that prepare and accelerate enterprise conversations: one-pagers, decks, whitepapers, case studies
  • Build and run inbound growth motions: SEO, AI search optimization, and targeted growth experiments
  • Close the loop with Sales: instrument what's working, kill what isn't, feed campaign learnings back into product and positioning

Employer Branding

  • Build NaroIQ's employer brand into a real asset: a careers narrative that pulls senior talent in, a candidate experience that earns referrals
  • Position NaroIQ as one of the most attractive places to work in European FinTech; through content, events, founder presence, and glimpses into the lived experience of the team

Requirements

(You don't need to know it all - but you should be ready to dive in, learn fast, and take initiative.)

  • Experience in B2B marketing: Ideally in financial services or at an AI / enterprise startup
  • You can create a brand, not just run one: you've built positioning and narrative for a product or category, ideally while the product was still moving
  • Creative and strong at storytelling: You can draft an explanatory case study, a press pitch that lands, and a job description that pulls. Without slipping into FinTech buzzwords

  • Data-driven: You think in KPIs and processes, and use them to make the work sharper

  • A taste-led approach to brand: you can hold a consistent visual and verbal system across surfaces and push back on output that breaks it
  • Structured and genuinely self-directed: you're comfortable operating with ambiguity, high ownership and no cover in a small, fast-moving team
  • Fluent in English and German, written and spoken

Nice to have: existing relationships with FinTech or asset-management journalists; experience building a careers brand from scratch; familiarity with growth tooling (SEO, attribution, growth-hacking stacks).

Why NaroIQ

We're building something ambitious - and we believe the only way to do that is with a team that's low-ego, high-impact, and genuinely excited about what they're doing.

Über QESTIT

QESTIT ist ein auf Qualitätssicherung spezialisiertes Beratungsunternehmen mit Fokus auf Testmanagement und Organisationsberatung entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycle, SAP und Non-SAP, mit und ohne KI. Als Teil der international aufgestellten QESTIT Group sind wir in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz, Schweden, Frankreich und Ägypten tätig. In Deutschland arbeiten wir aus Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Köln, Görlitz und München.

Deine Rolle

Wir entwickeln uns weiter: vom operativen Testmanagement hin zur Organisations- und Prozessberatung rund um die Qualitätssicherung im gesamten SDLC. Testing bleibt dabei unser Kern. Unsere Beraterinnen und Berater arbeiten meist allein oder in kleinen Teams direkt beim Kunden. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Engagement Lead verantwortest du die Ergebnisse und die Kundenzufriedenheit ausgewählter Accounts im DACH-Raum. Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf, steuerst laufende Vorhaben als Projektleitung, auch wenn der Kunde diese Rolle nicht separat beauftragt, und baust die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden gezielt aus. Deine Rolle ist an Accounts und Projekten ausgerichtet, nicht an einer Region.

Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung und bist Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung der QESTIT GmbH. Du führst fachlich, die disziplinarische Führung liegt bei unseren Delivery-Center-Leitungen, mit denen du eng und auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitest. Perspektivisch kann die Rolle um disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung wachsen.

Deine Aufgaben

Projekte und Accounts steuern

  • Du übernimmst für deine Bestandskunden die Projektleitung und steuerst Scope, Budget, Timeline und Risiken im Rahmen der Projektverträge

  • Du setzt neue Kundensituationen methodisch auf: Zielbild, Vorgehen (klassisch, agil oder hybrid) und Team-Setup

  • Du legst das methodische Vorgehen in deinen Projekten fest und gibst den Teams die Richtung bei der Erarbeitung der Ergebnisse gemeinsam mit dem Kunden vor

  • Du sicherst die Qualität zentraler Liefergegenstände, bevor sie an den Kunden gehen, und gibst sie frei

Team anleiten und Standards setzen

  • Du leitest unsere Beraterinnen und Berater fachlich und methodisch an und coachst sie in ihren Einsätzen

  • Du meldest Staffing-Bedarfe für deine Accounts an und entscheidest bei der Besetzung deiner Projekte maßgeblich mit

  • Du entwickelst Standards, Playbooks und Templates und sorgst für einheitliche Qualitätsstandards über deine Projekte hinweg

Kunden entwickeln und transparent berichten

  • Du erkennst Wachstumspotenzial in deinen Accounts und hebst es gemeinsam mit unserem Sales-Team

  • Du gestaltest Angebote für deine Accounts aktiv mit

  • Du berichtest der Geschäftsführung regelmäßig über den Status deiner Accounts

  • Du sprichst Risiken früh und offen an und eskalierst, wenn nötig, gegenüber der Geschäftsführung und gegenüber dem Kunden

Dein Profil

Fachlich

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Qualitätssicherung, Testmanagement und Beratung mit, idealerweise in einem Beratungsunternehmen

  • Du hast QA-Tiefe über den gesamten SDLC, von der Schnittstelle zum Requirements Engineering bis zur Testprozessreife

  • Du hast Erfahrung im SAP-Testmanagement (SAP Activate, Solution Manager bzw. Focused Build) und ebenso belastbare Erfahrung in Non-SAP-Projekten

  • Du setzt KI in der Qualitätssicherung gezielt ein, etwa bei der Testdatengenerierung oder im autonomen Testen

Methodik und Projektmanagement

  • Du bist in klassischen und agilen Vorgehensmodellen (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) gleichermaßen sicher und wählst situativ, was zur Reife des Kunden passt, in der Praxis meist hybrid

  • Du beherrschst das Handwerk der Projektsteuerung: Scope, Risiken, Budget und Stakeholder

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Organisations- und Prozessberatung und im Change Management, von der Ist-Aufnahme bis zu Zielbild und Roadmap

Persönlich

  • Du führst ohne disziplinarische Linie: Du coachst, moderierst Konflikte und gibst Struktur

  • Du trittst souverän auf Entscheiderebene auf und hast ein unternehmerisches Gespür für Potenziale im laufenden Projekt

  • Du kommunizierst klar und ehrlich, auch wenn die Nachricht unbequem ist

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und sehr gut Englisch

  • Du bist bereit, im DACH-Raum zu unseren Kunden zu reisen

Von Vorteil

  • Zertifizierungen wie PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 oder SAFe; sie sind für uns ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Kunden in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Eine neu geschaffene Schlüsselrolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst, wie wir Beratung bei QESTIT liefern

  • Eine klare Entwicklungsperspektive: Perspektivisch übernimmst du auch disziplinarische Führungsverantwortung

  • Ein Platz in der Geschäftsleitung mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung

  • Anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte im DACH-Raum, SAP und Non-SAP, mit und ohne KI

  • Ein internationales Umfeld mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in sechs Ländern

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und ein wertschätzendes, unkompliziertes Miteinander

Kontakt & Bewerbung

Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.
