title: Account Executive - London
description:
About Us

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

  • Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

  • Create engaging ways to show our product

  • Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

  • Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

  • Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

  • Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

  • Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

  • Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

  • Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

  • Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

  • Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

  • Previous POS/ Hospitality tech sales is a strong plus

  • You are comfortable working in English

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Flexible time off

  • Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre
description:
Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career?

At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit.

We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle.

Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you.

We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Wednesday 18th November, giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients.

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.

Opportunities Available

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.

What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre?

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions

  • Working effectively with others

  • Organisation and the ability to follow processes

  • Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy

  • Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.

What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

  • Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.

  • Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.

  • Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.

  • Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.

  • Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.

  • Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.

About Montu

Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK.

Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do.

Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey.

We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey.

Why Join Montu?

Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference.

We offer:

  • Competitive salaries dependent on the position, qualifications and experience

  • Opportunities for training and professional development

  • Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment

  • The opportunity to gain experience within a specialist area of healthcare

  • The chance to be part of a growing business helping improve patient access to prescribed medication

Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Join Us?

Location: Winnersh Triangle, Berkshire

If you are looking for an opportunity to begin a career in pharmacy, develop your existing skills or take the next step within a growing healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you.

title: Anaesthetic (Pain) Consultant
description:
At Montu UK, we are passionate about improving the lives of patients who have often exhausted conventional treatment options. Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

We are looking for Consultant Anaesthetists who are interested in exploring the growing field of medical cannabis and developing their expertise in chronic pain management.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes.

With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine.

Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care.

What is the job?

As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options.

Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine.

Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care.

Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management

As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales, delivered fully online in partnership with Learna.

The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team.

About the diploma

  • A 12-month, part-time postgraduate diploma with all teaching and assessment completed online.

  • Focuses on interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary pain management, assessment and service provision.

  • Full course fees funded by Montu UK.

  • Two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

Further information about the programme is available through the University of South Wales.

Eligibility

  • A minimum working commitment of 24 hours per week with Montu.

  • Two of those hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time.

  • Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

What will you be doing?

  • Providing high-quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment for chronic pain and other qualifying conditions.

  • Conducting patient consultations, including clinical assessments, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient management.

  • Applying anaesthetic expertise in analgesic pharmacology, drug interactions and opioid stewardship to support safe prescribing.

  • Reviewing patient progress and treatment effectiveness, making adjustments where clinically appropriate.

  • Engaging in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence-based practice.

  • Contributing to clinical governance and maintaining robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Completing the sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management alongside clinical responsibilities.

  • Participating in ongoing training and professional development, including specialist training in cannabis-based prescription medicines.

What you need

  • Full GMC registration with a current licence to practise.

  • Completion of specialist training in Anaesthesia (CCT/CCST) or equivalent.

  • Entry on the GMC Specialist Register for Anaesthesia.

  • Strong knowledge of analgesic pharmacology, pain management and safe prescribing.

  • Excellent communication skills and a patient-centred approach to care.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a multidisciplinary clinical team.

  • A strong interest in chronic pain and alternative treatment options.

  • Willingness to participate in clinical outcome data collection and reporting.

  • Ability to commit to a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

Previous chronic pain experience is welcome but not essential, as the sponsored diploma and comprehensive in-house training will support professional development.

Why join us?

  • Competitive Salary: £170,000 FTE, pro rata for contracted hours.

  • Funded Postgraduate Diploma: Full course fees for the Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management, plus two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

  • Flexible Working: Fully remote working with flexible clinical sessions and a minimum commitment of 24 hours per week.

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for work undertaken within the role.

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on-call requirements.

  • Specialist Training: Access to CPD-accredited medical cannabis education and specialist training from experienced clinicians.

  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals.

  • Professional Development: Build expertise in chronic pain management and contribute to an evolving area of medicine.

Training & Development

  • Fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales.

  • Regular CPD sessions to support ongoing professional development, appraisal and revalidation.

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training in clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's clinical systems.

  • Appraisal and revalidation support where Montu is the main employer.

Working arrangements

  • Remote Role: Fully remote working with flexibility around working days and hours.

  • Weekly Commitment: A minimum of 24 hours per week, consisting of 22 hours of clinical work and two hours of protected, paid study time.

  • Sessions: Standard clinical sessions consist of four hours of patient consultations, with flexibility to arrange sessions around preferred working days and hours.

  • Appointment Durations: 15 minutes for new and existing patients.

  • Multidisciplinary Support: Nurses and pharmacists support pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing and patient care.

Our multidisciplinary model enables consultants to focus on their clinical expertise while benefiting from the support of an experienced wider healthcare team.

What we offer

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

Postgraduate Diploma Sponsorship Terms and Conditions

  • A minimum commitment of 24 hours per week is required throughout the diploma programme.

  • Two hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time.

  • Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week is required for the duration of the diploma.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. title: Platform Engineer
description:
TL;DR: This is not a regular engineering job. We're looking for exceptional builders who help us design and ship systems that define how the world's largest companies operate in the age of AI.

WHY CONDUCT
The world's largest companies are slowed down by the software they run on. We're building the AI operating system that absorbs IT complexity and unlocks entirely new levels of speed, output, and ambition. We believe this is a generation-defining mission.

Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we just closed a $60M+ Series A from top-tier funds, and we're still early enough that what you build here defines the company.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work at Conduct - we value ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. If you bring that same drive, we will make sure this is the place you do yours too.

WHO WE HIRE
We are relentless builders, and we're looking for people who share that obsession with shipping to customers.

As our founding Platform Engineer, your role is to build and scale a reliable, resilient, observable, performant and secure platform that makes our product engineers faster. We care about outcomes: you should be excited by building the foundations that let us ship a killer product fast, not by hard infrastructure problems for their own sake (though you'll have plenty of those).

You'll stand out if you:

  • Have owned infrastructure - networks, databases, deployments - through a period of real scale at a fast-growing startup or scale-up.

  • Treat infrastructure as code by default (Terraform or similar) and stay on top of the latest platform tooling

  • Simple, well-reasoned system design. Solutions that solve the problem and ship fast, rather than the perfect setup on a six-month roadmap

  • Have informed, strong opinions on the big calls - like whether to stay on Postgres or move to something like Supabase or PlanetScale

  • Understand how AI changes infrastructure - LLM gateways, caching, flaky providers, agent sandboxes, durable execution. You don't need to be an AI researcher, but you've played with the tools and have a point of view

  • Build clean abstractions and paved paths that other engineers actually want to use

We look for exceptional talent, regardless where you spike. Experience level matters less than the quality of your thinking and the evidence of what you've shipped; building and scaling platforms with modern tooling, rather than just maintaining them.

We hire the best to join our team in London, wherever they come from (we sponsor visas and provide relocation support!). We're convinced diverse teams ship better products and especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN
Everything that sits below the product code. Today that work is shared across the team; you'll own it, with the autonomy to set the direction, decide what matters most, as well as scope and prioritise work yourself with the backing of the broader engineering team. As our engineering team grows fast, every improvement you make compounds across everyone building Conduct.

  • Deployment: fully automated, repeatable deployments of the whole platform, so we can stand up new regions - starting with the US.

  • Enterprise-grade security: customer-provided encryption keys, network boundaries and tenant isolation that hold up to the scrutiny of the world's largest companies

  • Bringing core services in-house: running durable execution, vector search and agent sandboxes inside our own infrastructure rather than renting them as a service

  • Data: scaling and tuning our databases, and owning where our data layer goes next

  • Developer experience: a fast, reliable local setup, preview environments from any branch, and build tooling and CI that keep up with a growing team

  • Observability: end-to-end tracing, structured logging and alerting that product engineers can self-serve

  • AI infrastructure: our LLM gateway, model routing, cost monitoring and resilience to flaky providers

OUR STACK
Our stack prioritises what matters: shipping to customers—fast—without compromising on quality and engineering.

Fundamentals are more important to us than familiarity with any technology or tool: if you're strong, we're sure you'll pick it up fast.

Here's our setup:

  • Azure, managed with Terraform: everything as code, with multi-cloud integrations for LLM providers across AWS, GCP and others

  • Kotlin and TypeScript services in a containerised monorepo, with CI/CD on GitHub Actions

  • Temporal and PortKey: durable execution and enterprise-compliant LLM routing at the core of our platform

  • Postgres for our data layer, with TurboPuffer for vector search

  • Agent sandboxes running on Daytona and other providers

  • OpenTelemetry and Honeycomb for observability

Who You Are

This is a chance to grow faster than you would at a traditional insurer or claims business.

If you’re ready to step up, work hard, and build a career in claims, we’d love to hear from you.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

Product Manager, Lead to Cash

Location: London, onsite 5 days a week

Retire The ERP.

Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business.

Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance.

About The Role

This is a hands-on product role reporting to the VP of Product Development. You’ll own Lead to Cash: everything between a signed deal and cash in the bank. That covers contracts, billing and invoicing, revenue recognition, payments, and credit control. You’ll set the roadmap for the area with the VP, and your discovery and judgement decide what actually ships.

In Lead to Cash, the ledger has to keep up with whatever commercial terms each customer signs. A contract changes mid-term, and the invoices, deferred revenue and reporting all have to follow. A parent company wants one bill for a dozen subsidiaries. A customer’s Stripe setup doesn’t match how they actually sell. Every customer bills a little differently, and the product has to absorb those differences without turning into a pile of one-offs. You work out which problems are patterns worth building for and which aren’t, and you say so.

Your stakeholders are engineers, designers, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, and the Financial Controllers, Finance Directors and CFOs who run their revenue on Light. Most of them are senior, technical and short of time. They expect you to keep up, and to be honest with them when a request would cost more than it’s worth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Lead to Cash roadmap and its delivery, from discovery to go-live, and the metrics that show whether it’s working for customers

  • Turn contract terms, pricing models and revenue recognition rules into product requirements engineers can build from

  • Decide which customer requests become product and which don’t, and bring a clear recommendation to the VP of Product Development when the call is a big one

  • Lead discovery with finance teams: sit with them through a billing run or a month-end close and find what’s slow, manual or wrong

  • Work with Sales and Solutions Engineering on what gets promised to customers, before it’s promised

  • Sequence delivery with Engineering and Design without cutting the corners that matter in finance

  • Own the integrations that feed Lead to Cash, such as CRMs and payment providers, with clear scope for each

  • Spot a release going off-track before it slips, and escalate or intervene early

  • Enable the teams downstream of you (Sales, SE, Implementation, Support) to sell, set up and support every Lead to Cash feature from day one

  • Shape how AI agents run billing and collections work, inside policies that finance teams set and can audit

Experience & Qualifications*

We’re looking for someone with around 4–8 years in product (or equivalent experience), who brings:

  • You ship product, not slideware. You’ve owned real features that real users depend on. You measure yourself by what went live and what it changed, not by the roadmap you maintained. This is the non-negotiable.

  • You turn accounting rules into product. You can read IFRS 15 or ASC 606, a customer’s master services agreement, or a messy pricing sheet and work out what the product has to do. You know why a mid-term upgrade, a backdated discount or an early termination breaks a simple billing model, and you design for it before a customer finds it.

  • You know revenue. You understand order-to-cash in practice: contracts, billing schedules, deferred and recognised revenue, credit notes, dunning, and matching cash against invoices. You can talk confidently with a Controller about how revenue should land in the books. An accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or local equivalent) is a strong plus, and so is time spent running billing or revenue operations yourself.

  • You can say no, explain why, and keep the relationship intact. Lead to Cash attracts customer-specific requests, and many arrive already promised. You can tell a pattern from a one-off, explain the cost of each to Sales and to customers, and turn the patterns into product that serves the next customer as well as this one.

  • You’re AI-native. You’ve changed the way you work because of AI tooling, not just added it to your workflow. You use it to read contracts and pricing models, prototype, draft specs and pressure-test your own thinking, and you have an instinct for where it helps, where it misleads, and how to use it without losing ownership of the outcome.

  • You own discovery. You talk to customers directly and often: their finance teams, the people who run their billing, and our own Sales and Implementation teams who set them up. You can tell the difference between what a customer asks for and the problem underneath it, and you turn that into the smallest thing worth building next.

  • You deliver through other people. You’ve shipped through Product, Engineering, Design and Sales without formal authority over any of them. You build trust with senior finance stakeholders through clear communication and consistent delivery.

  • Fluent English; additional European languages a plus.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building billing, subscription or revenue recognition products, or running billing at a SaaS company

  • Familiarity with billing and payment platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee or Zuora, and CRMs such as HubSpot or Salesforce

  • Experience in fintech or systems where data integrity is non-negotiable

  • Experience with usage-based, tiered or hybrid pricing models

  • Background in high-growth startups where everything was still being figured out

  • Familiarity with multi-currency, multi-entity billing and e-invoicing mandates (e.g. Peppol, Italy’s SDI)

You’ll Probably Struggle Here If

  • You need a finished spec handed to you. Here the “requirement” is often a contract clause or a pricing sheet nobody has turned into product yet.

  • You need a PMO, a mature methodology or a big delivery org around you to operate. This is a startup environment, and ownership and a self-starter nature are key.

  • You treat every customer request as a commitment. The job is deciding which ones become product.

  • You find it hard to say no to a customer or colleague, even when it’s the right call.

  • You haven’t yet changed how you work because of AI. We go all in on AI at Light and want people who share that.

Our Tech Stack

We build on AWS, with a Kotlin backend, a React frontend, and infrastructure managed in Terraform. It’s a real production system that global finance teams depend on every day.

You won’t be writing the code, but you’ll live alongside it. You do need to be comfortable in this kind of environment: real scale, real customers, real stakes.

The Good Stuff

In addition to being part of a great team and working in a fun and innovative environment, we offer:

💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 A generous paid annual leave package, plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 A huge opportunity for career growth as you help shape a market-defining product.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

Working at Light means you’re embarking on an exciting journey to reshape the future of multinational financial operations. Our cheat code is that we’ve built something like this before, and now we’re doing it again, only better. Our goal is to make global finance effortless and empower companies to make informed decisions.

Join the rocket ship while it’s taking off 🚀

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
About Better Collective

Sports media at scale, running on data

Better Collective is a global sports media group, reaching more than 400 million monthly visits across a portfolio of leading sports media brands.

We build products and experiences that make sports more engaging and accessible for fans around the world. Behind that sits a large and diverse technology and data landscape, spanning markets, brands and business models.

We work in a collaborative environment where people are encouraged to challenge how things are done, take ownership and help shape what comes next.

The domain

Paid media is where the data has to pay off.

We spend real money across dozens of ad networks every day. Which campaigns scale, which creatives get cut, which markets get more budget: those calls come out of the models this team builds.

Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, CRM data, all stitched into one user-level view of what a click was actually worth. That model exists and it works.

It is also the most demanding domain on our data platform - the most sources, the fastest schema churn, and the shortest patience for a table that landed late.

We are looking for the engineer who owns it.

Where this role sits

A central platform team sets the how. You set the what.

Better Collective runs a hub and spoke data organisation. A central data platform team owns the platform itself - MotherDuck, dbt, Dagster, DLT, the golden paths, the standards, the infrastructure. Paid Media Insights is a domain team, a spoke, that builds on it.

The split is deliberate and we hold to it. The platform team decides how data is produced here. You decide what paid media produces, and you own everything we run.

So you are not starting a new stack, and you are not going to spend your year on plumbing that a central team should be solving once for everyone.

You are, however, expected to be a demanding customer. When a golden path does not fit paid media, we want you to say so and push for it to change, not quietly build around it.

You will report to the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights and work across Paid Media, with the Campaign, Commercial and CRM teams, as well as with the central platform team.

What you will own

Every data job in paid media. All of it.

Freshness, cost, reliability, alerting, and the incident at 07:30 before the spend review. If a paid media model is wrong or late, it is yours, not the platform team's. That accountability is the core of this role, not a footnote to it.

Concretely, you will own:

  • The end-to-end user-level model. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, and CRM, joined into one view the business trusts enough to move budget on.

  • Ingestion of paid media sources, built on the platform's framework. Which sources, which schemas, and what happens the next time a network changes its API without telling anyone.

  • The domain's models, from staging through to the marts analysts and business teams actually query, plus the semantic meaning that sits on top of them. Nobody at the centre can define what a qualified signup means in paid media. You can.

  • Reverse ETL back into the ad platforms, so online and offline conversion data lands where it changes bidding.

  • The handover. Part of your first year is taking over the paid media jobs the central team still runs on our behalf, and moving that ownership to where the context actually lives.

What you will lead

A group of engineers, and the standard they build to

You will guide and mentor a group of data engineers in Paid Media Insights, as their technical lead. That means setting the standard for how this domain builds, reviewing their work, unblocking them, and deliberately growing them: giving away the interesting problems rather than keeping them.

You will also shape the domain's roadmap together with the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights, the analysts and the business teams, and you will represent paid media in platform conversations, including how we support machine learning and data science on top of this data.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a step away from building. You will be in the code.


What we are looking for

More than a stack match, we are looking for a particular way of working.

You take ownership, and it shows up in the boring parts. Plenty of engineers want to design the model. You also want the pager. You would rather own a domain end to end, unglamorous parts included, than build one piece and hand off the consequences. When things get tricky, you follow through.

You break complex systems into simple parts. Paid media data is genuinely messy: attribution windows, late conversions, identity across platforms, and dozens of source APIs that all disagree. You can hold that complexity and still hand the business something they can reason about.

You raise the people around you. You are the person colleagues come to for technical advice, and you enjoy that part of the job. You give feedback that lands, you review generously, and you would rather the whole team understand the pipeline than be the only one who does.

You work well with a platform team. You have strong opinions about standards and you are still happy to work inside someone else's. You know the difference between a constraint worth fighting and a preference worth dropping, and you would rather help fix a shared path than fork it.

You are already past prompting. AI is part of how you engineer, not something you occasionally ask questions. You have experimented with agents, tooling or AI-enabled workflows, and you have a view on what a data domain has to look like for them to be useful on top of it: documented, standardised, semantically clear. Paid media is likely where we find out first.

You are close to the business. You will sit with marketers and analysts who are spending budget on what you build. You want that proximity, and you can talk about data with people who do not think in tables.

You are technically deep where it counts. Production pipelines in SQL and Python, modelling and orchestration tooling such as dbt and Dagster, cloud data warehousing, and a real feel for performance, cost and reliability at scale. Experience with paid media or attribution data, or with machine learning pipelines, is a bonus rather than a requirement.

Not sure you meet every single requirement? That is okay. Your unique experience might be exactly what we are looking for.

Our stack

What you will build on

MotherDuck / DuckDB   ·   dbt   ·   Dagster   ·   DLT   ·   Python   ·   SQL   ·   AWS   ·   reverse ETL and semantic layer tooling

We do not expect you to have worked with all of these. If you have built production pipelines on Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift and you are curious about where we are going, that transfers.

What we offer

An international company in growth, and a flat structure

Join a strong team where you can create value and make a real business impact, in a dynamic and creative environment with a flat organisational structure. Freedom with responsibility, ample room to grow, and the chance to take on a broad set of responsibilities.

Flexible working hours supporting a healthy work-life balance, private health insurance, and office perks including lunch, snacks, gym access and social events, alongside skilled, passionate and fun colleagues.

title: Lead Solution Architect – D365 F&O Finance & SCM (f/m/x)
description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

What you'll do

Enpal is transforming its ERP landscape from a traditional D365 F&O setup into an Agentic Enterprise, a clean D365 core with an AI-native execution layer on top. AI-native product squads, organized by E2E process domain (D2O, O2C, P2P, SCE, R2R, MDG), replace traditional workstream towers. Each squad includes a Business Intent Owner (BIO), a Technology Orchestrator, Context Engineers, and Harness Engineers. This role sits in the Finance (R2R, O2C, MDG) squad and is a core contributor to building the agentic operating model that will power Enpal at scale.

As A Lead Solution Architect, you own the Finance & SCM architecture across D365 F&O, defining how GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, and Project Accounting are structured, governed, and evolved across 30+ legal entities. You set the design standards that functional consultants, developers, and partners work within, lead the decisions that are hard to reverse, and ensure that the Finance platform is the trusted, auditable system of record that a complex, multi-entity enterprise demands. In the agentic enterprise, you are also the architectural authority for the Finance agent layer, ensuring that Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate on a platform that is deterministic, traceable, and financially compliant.

FINANCE ARCHITECTURE & AGENTIC FOUNDATION

  • Define, govern, and evolve the Finance architecture across modules: GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, and Cost Accounting

  • Design the architectural foundation for Finance AI agents, ensuring the D365 core provides the deterministic ledger, traceable decisions, and full audit trail that agentic operations require

  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, regulatory requirements (IFRS/local GAAP), and global design principles across all legal entities

  • Translate complex Finance business requirements into robust D365 F&O designs, clean-core first, with customizations only where legally required or business-critical

STANDARDIZATION & GLOBAL ROLLOUT

  • Drive standardization, harmonization, and process simplification across regions and legal entities, ensuring the pilot BU design is locked and rolled out consistently

  • Ensure all Finance solutions are designed in a reliable, robust, and scalable way, ready for rollout across 30+ legal entities in the M9–M15 timeframe

  • Lead solution governance, blueprinting, and architectural decision-making across the Finance domain

  • Provide thought leadership on best practices, industry trends, and Microsoft ecosystem capabilities, including Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Fabric

DELIVERY LEADERSHIP & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

  • Provide hands-on guidance to functional consultants, developers, and integration teams, ensuring high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and hypercare

  • Ensure high-quality delivery across design, build, testing, cutover, and support phases

  • Represent Finance architecture in ERP governance forums, design authority reviews, and steering committees up to CFO level

What you'll bring

  • Extensive experience in ERP Finance & SCM transformation, with significant hands-on experience in D365 F&O Finance across multiple modules and global rollouts

  • Proven architectural leadership designing end-to-end Finance solutions, including integrations, data models, extensions, and ISV evaluations, ideally within high-growth or complex organizations

  • Deep functional expertise in core Finance processes (GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash & Bank, Project Accounting, Cost Accounting) and strong understanding of IFRS/local GAAP

  • Strong fluency in D365 F&O architecture, including data entities and integration patterns

  • Understanding of or strong interest in agentic AI in Finance: how Continuous Close Agents, Revenue Assurance Agents, and Collections Agents operate, and what the platform must provide to support them

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, including Finance Directors and CFO, with clear communication and decision-making

  • Experience leading global implementations across multiple legal entities, including fit-gap analysis, blueprinting, solution governance, and change management

  • Collaborative leadership mindset that brings cross-functional teams together and drives clarity in complex global programs

  • Fluency in English; German is a plus

Finance is the most governance-critical domain in Enpal's ERP transformation. title: Founding Customer Value Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von 15 Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 40 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut. Lasst uns sie von Anfang an richtig bauen.

Tasks

Customer Experience ist bei uns kein Support-Ticket-Job. Du besitzt den kompletten Kundenlebenszyklus nach dem Vertragsabschluss — kommerziell, operativ und im Produkt.

Damit sitzt du an der Stelle im Unternehmen, an der beide Seiten gleichzeitig sichtbar sind: Du weißt, was Kunden wirklich brauchen und wofür sie zahlen — und du weißt, was das Produkt kann und was es kosten würde, es zu können. Genau daraus entstehen die besten Produktentscheidungen und die besten Deals.

Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und baust den Bereich so, wie er in zwei Jahren für dreißig Leute funktionieren muss.

💰 Revenue Ownership

  • Du besitzt einen Kundenstamm mit klarer Umsatzverantwortung: Retention, Expansion, Renewals.

  • Du erkennst, wo ein Kunde mehr Wert ziehen könnte, und machst den Upsell selbst – weitere Nutzer, weitere Projekte, weitere Produkte.

  • Du verhandelst Verlängerungen und Erweiterungen und führst sie bis zur Unterschrift.

🚀 Value Creation über den gesamten Kundenlebenszyklus

  • Du übernimmst den Kunden ab dem ersten Onboarding-Kontakt: Setup, Projektdaten, Konfiguration, Schulung der Teams.

  • Du führst den Rollout vom Pilotprojekt in die Fläche – und sorgst dafür, dass die Nutzung nicht nach vier Wochen einschläft.

  • Du machst Value Reviews mit messbaren Zahlen statt Höflichkeitsterminen und machst sichtbar, was alago dem Kunden konkret gebracht hat.

🛟 Customer Support

  • Du verantwortest unseren Support: Anfragen beantworten, priorisieren, Muster erkennen.

  • Du debuggst Customer Flows in der Software selbst – du reichst ein Problem nicht weiter, du reproduzierst es, grenzt es ein und beschreibst es so, dass es lösbar ist.

  • Du baust Doku, Self-Service und KI-gestützte Antworten so auf, dass dieselbe Frage nicht zehnmal auf deinem Tisch landet.

⚙️ Product Engine – du baust mit

  • Du löst selbst, was sich ohne Engineering lösen lässt: Konfiguration, Datenbereinigung, kleine Automatisierungen und Skripte – mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder n8n. Was Code im Kernprodukt braucht, übergibst du so präzise an unser Engineering-Team, dass es schnell gelöst ist.

  • Du verantwortest Integrationen und Datenimporte: Du scopst die Anbindung an Kundensysteme, prüfst, was machbar ist, und bringst Migrationen gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering-Team ins Ziel – damit ein Onboarding Stunden statt Tage dauert.

  • Du bist die Stimme des Kunden im Produktprozess: Du übersetzt, was Nutzer, Projektleitungen, IT und QM wirklich brauchen, in klare, priorisierte Produkt-Inputs – mit Belegen, nicht mit Bauchgefühl – und testest neue Releases aus Kundensicht, bevor sie live gehen.

🏗️ Den Bereich aufbauen

  • Du schreibst die Playbooks für Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell – und automatisierst sie, wo immer es geht.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die KI-Agents und Automatisierungen, die Customer Experience bei uns skalierbar machen, statt den Bereich mit Köpfen zu vergrößern.

Requirements

Muss-Kriterien

  • Du hattest bereits direkten Kundenkontakt in einer verantwortlichen Rolle – du hast Kunden selbst geführt, nicht nur zugearbeitet

  • Du hast Umsatzverantwortung getragen oder Umsatz ausgebaut (Renewals, Upsells, Expansion, Abschlüsse) und kannst das mit Zahlen belegen

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, dauerhaft von hier aus zu arbeiten

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast selbst schon aktiv entwickelt – eigene Projekte, Skripte, Integrationen, ein Side Project, das tatsächlich läuft

  • Du hast schon mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren Coding-Agents) echte Sachen gebaut und weißt, wie weit man damit ohne Engineering-Team kommt

  • Du kennst Teile unseres Stacks (TypeScript, React, Supabase) schon aus eigenen Projekten

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits in einem schnell wachsenden Early-Stage-Startup gearbeitet und weißt, wie es sich anfühlt, wenn es noch kein Playbook gibt

  • Du hast schon einmal einen Bereich oder Prozess von null aufgebaut

Wie du arbeitest

  • AI-native: Du nutzt KI reflexhaft, nicht gelegentlich. Du hast eigene Agents, Automatisierungen oder Tools gebaut (n8n, Claude Code, Lovable o. Ä.), testest neue Modelle sofort und weißt, was taugt.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst das System hinter dem einzelnen Kunden. Beim zweiten Mal baust du den Prozess, der das manuelle Lösen überflüssig macht – und dokumentierst ihn für die nächste Person.

  • Technische Tiefe: Du prüfst Daten, verfolgst Flows, liest Logs und grenzt Probleme sauber ein – und behebst sie, wo es geht, selbst mit KI-Tools. Du bist in der Software zu Hause, nicht nur in der Präsentation darüber.

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss.

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Du wirst einer der tragenden Pfeiler dieser Firma

  • Du bist die erste Person für Customer Experience und bestimmst Prozesse, Tools, Standards und Kennzahlen. Was du baust, bleibt.

  • Customer Experience ist einer von sechs, sieben Bereichen, die alago tragen – und du besitzt ihn.

  • Du sitzt am Tisch, wenn die Entscheidungen fallen, die die Firma prägen. Der Weg führt zum Head of Customer Experience mit eigenem Team.

Du entwickelst dich in eines der gefragtesten Profile überhaupt

  • KI-Unternehmen suchen händeringend Leute, die Kunde und Produkt zugleich beherrschen – bei Palantir heißt das Forward Deployed Engineer.

  • Du lernst, Vertrauen aufzubauen, schwierige Gespräche zu führen und Kunden über Monate zu messbarem Wert zu begleiten.

  • Ab Tag eins Zugriff auf unsere Codebasis, Pairing mit dem Engineering-Team und echte Code-Reviews. Wer beides kann, hat danach jede Tür offen.

Du baust deine eigene Marke – und vervielfachst deinen Marktwert

  • Du begleitest unser Wachstum von 16 auf 30 Mitarbeitende in zwei Jahren.

  • Du knackst den Code, wie Onboarding, Rollout, Support und Upsell vorhersehbar und wiederholbar werden – und nimmst dieses Playbook überallhin mit.

Du beschleunigst deine Entwicklung

  • Ob eigene Gründung oder Head of Customer Experience: Halbjährliche Performance-Reviews, konkrete Entwicklungsschritte alle ~9 Monate.

  • Wöchentliche Trainings, erfahrene Coaches und Mentor:innen und eine umfangreiche Bibliothek.

Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern

  • Tag für Tag mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain).

  • Frühe Phase heißt: viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, in die Rolle zu wachsen, die zu deinen Stärken passt.

Zusätzlich

  • Wellpass, zweimal pro Woche Team-Dinner und Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

  • Arbeitsplatz im WERK1, einem der aktivsten Startup-Hubs Münchens.

Bewerbungsprozess

  1. Bewerbung

  2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten)

  3. Deep-Dive mit einem Founder (40 Minuten)

  4. Case Study (halber Tag vor Ort in München) – z. B. ein hängendes Rollout retten, einen Upsell-Case rechnen oder einen Customer Flow im Produkt debuggen

  5. Entscheidung – Rückmeldung innerhalb von 24 Stunden. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉

title: Projektmanager (m/w/d) MarTech – Content Supply Chain & Automatisierung | Vollzeit | Hybrid
description:
DIU ist IT-Dienstleister für MarTech-Lösungen (Marketing Technology: Technologien, mit denen Marketing- und Content-Prozesse geplant, automatisiert und ausgespielt werden) sowie AI & Cloud Services mit einer über 25-jährigen Tradition. An unseren zwei Standorten in Hamburg und Wiesbaden entwickeln, integrieren und betreiben wir IT-Lösungen für Unternehmen aus Handel, Versicherung, Medien und Industrie.

Zu unseren langjährigen Kunden zählen unter anderem OTTO, R+V Versicherung, Allianz Trade und Suzuki.

DIU ist geprägt von einer Kultur der Innovation und vom Anspruch, Technologie dort einzusetzen, wo sie messbar Wirkung erzeugt. Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der IT getreu unserem Motto: Unleash your power in IT.

Mehr zu uns: www.diu.digital

Aufgaben

WANTED

Unser Geschäftsbereich MarTech unterstützt Marketing-, Content- und Brand-Teams dabei, ihre Content Supply Chain, also den Weg von Inhalten von der Erstellung über Freigabe und Veredelung bis zur Ausspielung auf allen Kanälen, effizienter, automatisierter und KI-fähig aufzustellen. Wir orchestrieren Systeme, Prozesse und KI-Services toolunabhängig. Wo keine passende Standardlösung existiert, bauen wir schlanke, eigene Lösungen und bewerten jede Entscheidung wirtschaftlich im Interesse unserer Kunden.

Du suchst eine Rolle, in der du Projektverantwortung, Beratungskompetenz und eigenes technisches Umsetzen verbindest? Dann wird DIU interessant für dich. Bei uns sind die Wege kurz, Entscheidungen transparent und Zusammenarbeit professionell. Als Projektmanager (m/w/d) MarTech verantwortest du Projekte rund um Automatisierungslösungen, Marketing Production Automation (kurz: MPA) und die Integration von Systemen der Content Supply Chain. Kleinere Automatisierungen, Prototypen und Integrationen setzt du selbst um, zum Beispiel mit Claude Code, MCP-Servern oder Low-Code-Plattformen.

Wir schreiben die Position im Raum Hamburg im Hybrid-Modell mit 1–2 Tagen Office pro Woche aus. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Teamlead zusammen und entlastest ihn. Dein Team ist auf die Standorte Hamburg und Wiesbaden verteilt und arbeitet schon länger in dieser Besetzung zusammen.

DOINGS

  • Du planst, steuerst und setzt Projekte entlang der Content Supply Chain um: Automatisierungslösungen, MPA-Services und Systemintegrationen.

  • Du analysierst Content-Prozesse bei unseren Kunden, identifizierst Automatisierungspotenziale und übersetzt Anforderungen in fachliche und technische Aufgaben.

  • Du entwickelst einfache technische Lösungen selbst, etwa Workflow-Automatisierungen, Schnittstellen, Prototypen oder Self-Service-Tools, unterstützt durch KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code und MCPs.

  • Du berätst Kunden zu Workflows, Datenflüssen, Schnittstellen und dem sinnvollen Einsatz von KI im Content-Prozess.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass sich Lösungen reibungslos in bestehende MarTech-Landschaften und Prozesse einfügen.

  • Du verantwortest Projektplanung, Zeitpläne, Budgets und Ressourcen für deine Projekte.

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für Kunden, Fachbereiche und Entwicklung und sorgst für klare, regelmäßige Kommunikation.

  • Du übernimmst die fachliche Leitung von Teilprojekten und unterstützt den Teamlead bei Planung, Priorisierung und Steuerung.

Qualifikation

KNOWHOW

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich (Wirtschafts-/Medien-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung. Quereinsteiger mit passender Berufserfahrung sind herzlich willkommen.

  • Mehrjährige Projektmanagement-Erfahrung, bestenfalls in Projekten mit technischem Umsetzungscharakter.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du hast Freude daran, Lösungen selbst zu bauen, und hast erste Erfahrung mit Scripting, APIs oder Automatisierungsplattformen wie bspw. Make.

  • Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, MCP, LLM-APIs) oder große Lust, dich darin schnell einzuarbeiten.

title: Working Student B2G: Public Sector & Research Funding (f/m/d)
description:
01 · Why this role exists

This is not your typical student job.

B2G sounds boring, until you realise it's money from the state and you help win it. You'll work directly with our B2G Manager and the founders on funding that flows straight into RIZM's cash flow, and you'll see from the inside how the public sector decides and buys. Something most students never get to see.

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're building B2G as a new business line at RIZM, and we're looking for a working student to help build it from day one.

02 · What you'll do

  • Public funding as a growth channel: Help build the pipeline for Forschungszulage (Germany's R&D tax allowance), EU grants, ERDF (EFRE) and other programmes: scout new calls, prepare applications and keep track of our running programmes.

  • Connect research: Support our research collaboration with Stanford and help turn it into funded projects.

  • Build the machine, AI-first: Set up trackers, automations and AI workflows so our funding pipeline runs with as little manual work as possible. Your ideas count here.

  • Support ReNET-EV: Help with our part of the ERDF project ReNET-EV (grid-friendly energy supply for business parks in the Münster/NRW region): documentation, reporting and the rollout to more municipalities.

  • Get to know municipalities: Research how cities, municipal utilities and economic development agencies decide and buy, as groundwork for our first public-sector customers.

  • Build the data foundation: Collect public and municipal data that makes our models more precise at regional level.

03 · What you bring

  • Studies: You're enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme, e.g. public administration, political science, economics, business, energy, engineering or something similar.

  • Curiosity: The energy transition, municipal heat planning or how public funding works interest you. No prior experience needed.

  • Writing: You write clearly and in a structured way.

  • AI-native: You're curious about AI and enjoy building your own tools and workflows.

  • Ownership: You work independently and like to take responsibility.

  • Languages: Fluent German and good English.

04 · Why you should apply now

B2G is a new business line at RIZM. Join now and help shape it from the start.

  • Small team: You'll work actively and day to day with our full-time B2G Manager, not on the sidelines.

  • Real responsibility: In a business line we're building from scratch.

  • Founders: You work directly with them.

  • Insight: Into public funding, research projects and municipal decision-making.

  • Real customers: Our product already runs at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

  • Flexible hours: They fit around your studies.

05 · One click, then what?

For now it's just one small step: press Apply. Here is a sneak peek at what comes next.

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest sentences on these two questions.

  1. A mayor gives you 2 minutes. Which energy problem in their city would you tell them RIZM can help with?

  2. Research funding sounds dusty to most students, but we think it's not :) How would you convince your friends it's actually cool, in the language you'd really use with them?

After that:

  • Intro call: 15 minutes on video to get to know each other.

  • Meet the team: At our office, with the team and one of our founders. Then we decide together.

title: Head of SEO & AI Search (all genders)
description:
Über uns

Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg.

Deine Mission

Du beherrschst klassisches SEO in der Tiefe, mit mehrjähriger Senior-Erfahrung. Gleichzeitig ist dir klar: Kaum noch jemand sucht heute komplett ohne KI, sei es über ChatGPT, Gemini oder AI Overviews. Diesen Wandel willst du nicht nur beobachten, sondern aktiv gestalten. Klar ist dabei: Ohne solides SEO-Fundament funktioniert auch die beste GEO-Strategie nicht, deshalb bringst du beides mit.

Als Head of SEO & AI Search verantwortest du unseren SEO-Bereich strategisch, operativ und wirtschaftlich. Im Zentrum deiner Rolle stehen von Beginn an unsere größten und strategisch wichtigsten Bestandskunden: Hier baust du die SEO- und AI-Search-Strategie neu und mit voller Verantwortung auf Senior-Ebene auf, im direkten Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung des Kunden. Perspektivisch entwickelst du von dort aus den SEO-Bereich für weitere Kunden im Haus.

KI spielt dabei eine doppelte Rolle: erstens als Zielsystem, du machst Kunden auch in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen sichtbar. Zweitens als Arbeitsweise, du nutzt KI selbst für Recherche, Analysen, Briefings und Reporting. Ein fertiges Technik-Portfolio brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger sind echte Neugier und Lust, dich reinzuhängen. Bei uns wirst du zum KI-Poweruser deines Fachbereichs.

Was erwartet dich

  • AI Search & Sichtbarkeit – der Kern der Rolle, kein Nebenschauplatz: Du entwickelst Strategien, damit Inhalte in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini und Perplexity auffindbar, verständlich und zitierfähig sind. Du denkst Inhalte für generative Systeme mit: klar beantwortbare Absätze, saubere Q&A-Strukturen, belastbares Schema-Markup, damit KI-Systeme Inhalte einordnen und zitieren können.
  • Sichtbarkeit messbar machen: Du entwickelst Testsets und Prompt-Sammlungen, um systematisch zu beobachten, wann und wie Marken, Produkte und Inhalte in KI-Antworten genannt werden – idealerweise mit AI-Visibility-Tools wie Peec, Otterly oder Profound.
  • Einordnung statt Hype: Du ordnest GEO und AEO fachlich ein, statt Hype hinterherzulaufen, und vermittelst ehrlich, wo es heute schon belastbare Ergebnisse gibt und wo noch nicht.
  • Dein Case: Verantwortung von Tag eins. Du übernimmst die strategische, operative und wirtschaftliche Führung des SEO- und AI-Search-Mandats für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden, von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle. Du baust eine SEO- und GEO-Roadmap auf, die es in dieser Form bislang nicht gab, und verantwortest ihre Umsetzung.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung des Kunden souverän in Workshops, Audits und Reviews.


Dein Alltag: KI als deine tägliche Arbeitsweise

Hier geht es nicht um die Arbeit für Kunden, sondern um deinen eigenen Alltag: Viele wiederkehrende Aufgaben erledigst du bei uns spürbar schneller, weil du KI dafür einsetzt – kein Kür-Thema, sondern Standard. Zum Beispiel:

  • Keyword-Clustering und Content-Gap-Analysen per KI vorbereiten, statt sie komplett von Hand zu erstellen.
  • Erste Content-Briefings und Gliederungsentwürfe mit KI entwerfen.
  • Crawl- und Search-Console-Daten von KI vorauswerten, bevor du selbst tief einsteigst.
  • Wiederkehrende Reports automatisieren, statt sie jede Woche neu zusammenzuklicken.
  • Die Qualitätskontrolle bleibt trotzdem bei dir: KI-Ergebnisse werden von dir eingeordnet und geprüft, nicht blind übernommen.


Was solltest du mitbringen

  • Bei SEO erwarten wir echte Tiefe. Bei KI muss es kein Fachwissen oder Abschluss sein, aber komplett bei null solltest du auch nicht stehen. Die technischen Hürden legen wir bewusst niedrig, ein bisschen eigene Praxis braucht es trotzdem.
  • Mehrjährige SEO- und AI-Search-Erfahrung aus Agentur- oder vergleichbarer Unternehmensumgebung, mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen. Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend, wichtiger sind Tiefgang, Ergebnisse und Neugier.
  • Tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Technical SEO, Content SEO, Onpage- und Offpage-Optimierung.
  • Erfahrung mit ganzheitlichen SEO-Strategien und Roadmaps, die du für unterschiedliche Kunden von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle steuerst – inklusive technischer Audits (Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, strukturierte Daten), Relaunches und Migrationen.
  • Keyword-, Content- und Autoritätsstrategien, die echten Mehrwert statt reiner Keyword-Abdeckung liefern.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Search Console, GA4, Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs sowie Screaming Frog oder Sitebulb.
  • Ein Bewusstsein für den Wandel zu KI-gestützter Suche: GEO, AEO oder AI Visibility sind dir zumindest ein Begriff, und du willst dich darin vertiefen. Du hast bereits eigene Erfahrung mit KI-Tools gesammelt, und sei es nur privat (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co.). Ein Zertifikat oder eine Ausbildung brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger ist Lust, das jetzt systematisch für deine SEO-Arbeit einzusetzen.
  • Denken in Leads, Conversions und Kundennutzen statt nur in Rankings, dazu eine eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sicheres Englisch.


Warum VS Mediahouse

Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die etwas bewegen möchten, Mut für neue Ideen haben und das Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Neben unseren modernen Büros im Herzen von Freiburg erwarten dich ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem hoch dynamischen und wachstumsstarken Umfeld. Freue dich auf vielseitige Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie eine moderne, sachorientierte Entscheidungskultur ohne unnötige Hierarchien. Wir bieten dir fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Freiraum für Innovationen, kurze Entscheidungswege und individuelles Management-Coaching.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Wähle zwischen einem kostenfreien Jobticket (Deutschlandticket) oder nutze unser attraktives JobRad-Angebot.
  • Um dich fit und gesund zu halten, subventionieren wir deine Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft.
  • Du findest bei uns modernste Ausstattung mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen sowie Macbook & iPhone (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und natürlich ist das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice auch für uns kein Fremdwort.
  • Für Zwischendurch bedienst du dich an unserem regionalen Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Getränke und vieles mehr.
  • Neben deinem persönlichen Corporate Benefits Zugang erhältst du 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unserem Shop.
  • Erweitere deine Rente durch die Teilnahme an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
  • Abgerundet wird deine Zeit bei uns natürlich auch mit verschiedenen Team-Events und Feiern.


Klingt nach dir?

Wir suchen niemanden, der nur Rankings reportet, und genauso wenig einen reinen KI-Enthusiasten ohne SEO-Substanz. Sondern jemanden, der SEO in der Tiefe beherrscht, Lust hat, KI in den eigenen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren, und bereit ist, für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden von Anfang an echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Technisches KI-Vorwissen ist zweitrangig, echte Motivation nicht.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beschreibe uns stattdessen kurz zwei bis drei SEO-Projekte, für die du verantwortlich warst (Ausgangslage, deine Rolle, Ergebnis), und beantworte:

1. Wie nutzt du KI heute schon in deinem Alltag, und was reizt dich daran, KI-gestützte Suche zum Kernteil deiner Arbeit zu machen?

2. Wo hast du KI schon sinnvoll in einem SEO-Prozess eingesetzt? Falls noch nicht: Was würdest du als Erstes ausprobieren?

3. Wie misst du SEO-Erfolg, wenn Rankings und Klicks allein nicht mehr reichen?

Wenn du mehr über unsere Arbeitskultur und das Arbeitsumfeld erfahren möchtest, laden wir dich ein, die Bewertungen unserer Mitarbeiter auf Kununu zu lesen. Dort findest du ehrliche Meinungen und Feedback von aktuellen und ehemaligen Mitarbeitern.

This year, RIZM has created unprecedented savings at our customers. We just aren't telling anyone. If you love telling stories, let's talk.

title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Stadtwerke & Industrie | Süddeutschland
description:
Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner.



Technik aus dem Saterland. Wirkung weit darüber hinaus.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Dabei entwickeln wir uns kontinuierlich weiter und erschließen neue Anwendungsfelder für unsere Technologien. Gerade bei Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen entstehen neue Anforderungen und damit neue Möglichkeiten für moderne Lösungen zur Abgasnachbehandlung.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Sales Manager für Süddeutschland entwickelst du unser Geschäft mit Stadtwerken und Industriekunden weiter. Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, gewinnst neue Kunden, entwickelst bestehende Key Accounts und bringst unsere technischen Lösungen mit den Anforderungen unserer Kunden zusammen.

Du möchtest nicht einfach ein bestehendes Vertriebsgebiet verwalten, sondern Marktpotenziale erschließen, Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und ein Geschäftsfeld aktiv weiterentwickeln? Dann werde Emission Partner.

Was du bei uns bewirkst



Du bringst unsere Technologie dorthin, wo Emissionen entstehen und Lösungen gebraucht werden.

In deiner Region bist du nah an unseren Kunden und am Markt. Du sprichst mit Stadtwerken und Industrieunternehmen über ihre technischen Herausforderungen, erkennst neue Projekte und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen die passende Lösung.

Dabei geht deine Aufgabe über klassischen Produktvertrieb hinaus.

Du analysierst Märkte, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfelder und entscheidende Kunden, baust Netzwerke auf und entwickelst langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen.

Kurz gesagt: Du verkaufst nicht einfach ein Produkt. Du entwickelst mit uns einen Markt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst unser Geschäft mit Stadtwerken und Industriekunden in Süddeutschland strategisch weiter.
  • Du identifizierst Marktpotenziale, Wachstumsfelder und neue Anwendungsbereiche für unsere Lösungen zur Abgasnachbehandlung.
  • Du identifizierst relevante Zielkunden und sprichst potenzielle Neukunden aktiv an.
  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden und entwickelst aus ersten Kontakten langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen.
  • Du betreust ausgewählte Kunden als Key Accounts und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren technischen Fachbereichen passende Lösungen.
  • Du begleitest Projekte vom ersten Kundenkontakt über die technische und kaufmännische Abstimmung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen und bringst die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in unsere Vertriebsstrategie ein.
  • Du baust ein belastbares Netzwerk aus Kunden, Partnern und relevanten Marktteilnehmern auf.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing geeignete Maßnahmen zur Marktbearbeitung und Geschäftsfeldentwicklung.
  • Du bringst deine Markterfahrung in unser Vertriebsteam ein und unterstützt den internen Wissenstransfer.

Das bringst du mit



Uns ist wichtiger, dass du Kunden und Märkte entwickeln kannst und unsere Technik verstehen möchtest, als ein vollkommen geradliniger Lebenslauf.

  • Du hast eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung oder ein entsprechendes Studium abgeschlossen.
  • Du bringst idealerweise mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Vertriebsaußendienst mit.

Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Werde Emission Partner.



Technischer Service aus dem Saterland. Wirkung weit darüber hinaus.
